****[](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84867&L=38525&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS9NRzVRZ3Y1VThvVT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWFjdGlvbithbGVydCZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=06c8b7b23dfa7be76d4b38e56b4c87a2d72dae5c813ed167a494fbdf3811d420)******
****Christina Bobb is a senior attorney for Judicial Watch focused on national security law. She began her legal career in the United States Marine Corps, where she defended Marines and Sailors in courts-martial and administrative separation hearings. Ms. Bobb served multiple overseas tours, including Helmand Province, Afghanistan, and Stuttgart, Germany. After her military service, she transitioned to private practice at Higgs, Fletcher, & Mack LLP in San Diego, and then to Washington, DC, where she held executive-level positions within the Department of Homeland Security. Christina served as attorney for President Donald J. Trump from 2022-2024, when she transitioned to the Republican National Committee to assist election integrity efforts for the 2024 election. In 2023, Ms. Bobb authored her first book, “Stealing Your Vote: The Inside Story of the 2020 Election and What it Means for 2024.” Her second book, “Defiant: Inside the Mar-a-Lago Raid and the Left's Ongoing Lawfare” was released in 2025.

Peter,

I wanted you to hear this from me directly: **I'm excited to announce that Congresswoman Gwen Graham has agreed to serve alongside me as Florida's next Lieutenant Governor.**

I couldn't be more proud. And if you're as fired up about this as I am, I'm asking you to [split a donation with us and Blue Amp Action right now to help us launch this ticket the right way.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/14475?t=10&source={%&akid=2878%2E259176%2Evt0h-5 include_tmpl
custom_fields.mailing_source_code %})

Here's why this matters so much to me. Gwen and I served together in the House of Representatives, and I saw up close the kind of leader she is. We didn't just sit in the same room. We worked, side by side, on the issues that actually change people's lives. When we tell you we know how to get things done together, it's because we already have.

Gwen and I are aligned on the fights that matter most to Florida families:

We're going to take on the affordability crisis that's squeezing every household in this state, from housing to insurance to the cost of getting by.

We're going to expand health care access, because no Floridian should have to choose between seeing a doctor and paying the bills.

We're going to fight for our public schools. Education has been Gwen's life's work, and with her at my side, Florida's kids and teachers will finally have a champion in the governor's office.

And we're going to confront the gun violence that has taken too many Floridians and shattered too many families. Enough.

This is what a real partnership looks like. Two people who've done the work, who trust each other, and who are ready to bring change to Tallahassee.

**But here's the truth: a strong ticket isn't enough on its own. We're building a coalition to win this year, Democrats, Independents, and Republicans ready for something better, and a coalition like that runs on grassroots support. Yours.**

I want to explain how campaigns actually work, because it matters far more than most of the fundraising deadlines you hear about. Television time gets bought months in advance. The main House Republican super PAC booked its fall advertising back in the spring. They reserved $153 million worth of ads across the country, the biggest initial reservation in the group's history. Nearly $7 million of that is already reserved against me here in Southwest Washington. And that's just one Republican group. Donald Trump's MAGA Inc. is sitting on more than $400 million. Elon Musk has authorized at least $100 million in spending to help Republicans this fall. These aren't numbers someone made up for a fundraising email. This is money that already exists. And Republicans know exactly which races they need to win. **And I’m at the top of their list. **So when millions of dollars in attacks start running against me this fall, we can't wait until then to figure out how we'll respond. The money to answer them needs to already be sitting in our account. I know this is not the most exciting email I could send you. But I'd rather tell you how this actually works than pretend every fundraising deadline is an emergency. Here's the hard part. The Speaker of the House came to Southwest Washington last month to raise money for my opponent. He told the room this district will help decide who controls the House. He's right about that. They know exactly what this seat is worth, and they budgeted for it a long time ago. I don't have a super PAC. I've never taken corporate PAC money. What I have is people chipping in $5 and $10. And our biggest advantage right now is time. If we build the resources now, we can respond when it matters instead of watching millions of dollars in attacks hit the air while we scramble to catch up. clean_body: | It's Michele Tafoya, and you need to hear about what happened. I was on the ground for a professional women's basketball game recently, and it's astonishing to me how this has become ground zero for the Left's latest culture wars. I heard firsthand, Leftist activists shouting obscene remarks at women, simply for saying that men don't belong in girls' sports. | As a mother who 's passionate about youth sports, I felt the urge to intervene. I didn't go for the publicity... I went to stand up for something I'm passionate about and am prepared to staunchly defend. When I first launched this campaign for U.S. Senate in Minnesota, I knew I would have to prepare myself and my family for the pain and vitriol that would be slung my way. But, never in my wildest dreams would I imagine something so basic to be the cause of such heated debate. Biology isn 't complicated. Women are born with a specific set of chromosomes. So are men. They're different. That's why we have women's divisions in sports, so women can compete on a fair playing field. And every roster is finite. Every team excludes someone. That's not bigotry, that's how sports work. Women's sports should belong to women. If you can agree with me on that, then I have a feeling we'll be aligned on plenty of other things. Unfortunately, my far-Left candidate is not the same. She supports biological men in girls' sports, taxpayer-funded surgeries, and largely prefers lunacy over common sense. | Thanks for all that you do. Your support does not go unnoticed. Be brave. Do good. - Michele The Minnesota Senate polls are TIED when voters learn the TRUTH about Minnesota's fraud scandal! I'm not surprised. There isn't a single American who is pro-fraud. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillian Battino for Wisconsin
body:
I wanted to take a moment to reintroduce myself.
---
|
---
| [ ](https://battino4wi.com/l/IHJMXZFmCRwV)
---
Hey team,

With under 3 months until Election Day, I wanted to take a moment to reintroduce myself.

I developed a special interest in healthcare systems after working extensively in Central and South America building education and service programs so patients could access life-saving local healthcare. I learned that when you are working in medicine in developing parts of the world, you can expect to witness extreme suffering, including severe disease and people lacking access to basic medical care. **However, when I started seeing similar trends as a physician in Central Wisconsin, I was horrified.**

As a retired physician, I have dedicated years to supporting women fighting breast cancer. In that time, I have seen people come into the doctor's office with advanced cancer who knew that something was wrong, but were afraid to seek care. This wasn’t a one time incident, but more and more often, people who tell me that they couldn’t make it to the clinic because they had to milk their cows twice a day and didn’t have the support they needed to get there; their healthcare coverage had lapsed; they couldn’t pay their deductible; or simply that they were waiting for their life insurance policy to mature before seeking care.

**Regardless of whether they live in a city – big or small – or in a rural area, Wisconsinites face major hurdles in accessing care. That is why we need a fighter in Madison who will advocate for the people and lower costs for everyone.**

[**Please click here to commit to our campaign for a brighter future for all today.**](https://battino4wi.com/l/b0IqpTChafgK)
[SIGN YOUR NAME TO SUPPORT OUR CAMPAIGN](https://battino4wi.com/l/jsap0tDCMkMj) **In 2024, uncovered healthcare costs in Wisconsin were up 30%.** As a result, hospitals and clinics are closing, and some services are unavailable – this includes birthing centers, cancer, trauma, and primary care. Now, with Trump’s so-called Big Beautiful Bill, which made the largest cut to Medicaid in US history and failed to expand healthcare tax credits, **110,000 Wisconsinites are at risk of losing their coverage.**

This issue is deeply personal for me – not only because I worked hard for over 20 years to keep working families healthy, but because I am a lung cancer survivor.

I know firsthand how critical it is that folks have access to comprehensive, affordable care. And as the next senator of Wisconsin’s 29th Senate District, I will be a fierce advocate to ensure we finally start putting people over profit.

[**Please sign your name now to join our campaign to put Wisconsin families, farms, and businesses FIRST.**](https://battino4wi.com/l/TVSRaSNUn75r)

Thank you,

Gillian Battino
---

---

**Gillian Battino for Wisconsin**
PO Box 54
Wausau, WI 54402

Regardless of whether they live in a city – big or small – or in a rural area, Wisconsinites face major hurdles in accessing care. That is why we need a fighter in Madison who will advocate for the people and lower costs for everyone. In 2024, uncovered healthcare costs in Wisconsin were up 30%. As a result, hospitals and clinics are closing, and some services are unavailable – this includes birthing centers, cancer, trauma, and primary care. Now, with Trump’s so-called Big Beautiful Bill, which made the largest cut to Medicaid in US history and failed to expand healthcare tax credits, 110,000 Wisconsinites are at risk of losing their coverage. This issue is deeply personal for me – not only because I worked hard for over 20 years to keep working families healthy, but because I am a lung cancer survivor. I know firsthand how critical it is that folks have access to comprehensive, affordable care. And as the next senator of Wisconsin’s 29th Senate District, I will be a fierce advocate to ensure we finally start putting people over profit. Thank you, Gillian Battino | Prefer to donate via mail? Address a check to: Gillian Battino for Wisconsin PO Box 54 Wausau, WI 54402 | | Paid for by Gillian Battino for Wisconsin With so much at stake for the future of Wisconsin, we'd really hate to see you go. name: Al Franken
subject: The “Powwow” Story
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
Gizhiiwewidamookwe, means ‘speaks in a loud and clear voice woman.’
| Dear supporter,

I want to tell you about someone who’s unbelievably great. Someone who understands what’s at stake in this moment, who listens, who leads, and who embodies the values that make Minnesota, well, _Minnesotan_. That person is Peggy Flanagan. And she’s running to represent our great state in the U.S. Senate. [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125256?t=6&akid=27869%2E878179%2Ex5k8Rf) I’ve known Peggy for a long time. We both grew up in St. Louis Park (not at the same time — she’s young, and I’m old). Raised by a single mom, Peggy knows the impact of federal programs that help working families. They had a home because of a Section 8 housing voucher. Other public programs helped her mom afford health insurance and child care. **She gets it because she’s lived it.** And that’s exactly the kind of leader we need in Washington. (And frankly, what we have way too little of.) | [HELP ELECT PEGGY TO THE SENATE »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125256?t=7&akid=27869%2E878179%2Ex5k8Rf)
---
Peggy’s got the experience, too. She’s currently serving as Minnesota’s Lieutenant Governor — the highest-ranking Native American woman ever elected to executive office in the U.S. Before that, she was a state legislator, a school board member, an executive director for the Children’s Defense Fund–Minnesota, she even worked for ME!

But most importantly — she worked for my friend and hero, the late Senator Paul Wellstone. She and I both believe in his guiding principle: _We all do better when we all do better._ (Yes, it’s that simple. No, Republicans still don’t get it.)

While Republicans are hiding from their constituents, Peggy is doing the opposite. She’s traveling the state hosting ‘Kitchen Table Conversations’ — actually listening to _real_ Minnesotans, having real conversations, and working to bring people together. She doesn't just want to fight against bad stuff. She wants to build something, too.

Oh, and in case you’re wondering — yes, Peggy will be the first Native American woman ever elected to the U.S. Senate. It’s about time. She is Ojibwe and a member of White Earth, and her Anishinaabe name, Gizhiiwewidamookwe, means ‘speaks in a loud and clear voice woman.’ If there’s one thing I know about Peggy, it’s that she’ll use that voice to fight for all Minnesotans — whether they agree with her or not.

[So let’s make it happen. Split a donation with the Voter Protection Project today, and help send Peggy Flanagan to the Senate, where she’ll keep speaking up, fighting hard, and making sure we all have a good hotdish recipe.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125256?t=8&akid=27869%2E878179%2Ex5k8Rf)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Peggy Flanagan and VPP will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125257?t=9&akid=27869%2E878179%2Ex5k8Rf)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125258?t=10&akid=27869%2E878179%2Ex5k8Rf)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125259?t=11&akid=27869%2E878179%2Ex5k8Rf)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125260?t=12&akid=27869%2E878179%2Ex5k8Rf)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125261?t=13&akid=27869%2E878179%2Ex5k8Rf)
Al

P.S. I could go on and on about how great Peggy is. But instead, let me share a quick story from my first Senate campaign in 2008. Peggy was an organizer working with Native American communities and my advisor on Indian Affairs, and she told me if I went to the powwow at Red Lake, I should NOT dance. Good advice. But then a young man invited me to join in. So, I addressed the crowd and said, “Only if you don’t make fun of me after I leave.” They laughed and agreed, I danced, and a woman danced up to me and said, “You dance like a white guy.” I reminded her of the conditions of my dancing — to which she replied, “You said _after_ you leave.” That was my first lesson in Ojibwe humor.

I want to make sure you know a little bit about me and my story.

| Hi, Peter,
It’s Congresswoman Jen Kiggans here. I want to make sure you know a little bit about me and my story.
I’m not a career politician—just a Veteran, Nurse Practitioner, and Mom who wants to make a difference in America. I grew tired of seeing the endless stream of false promises and fake agendas on TV...I think America deserves better—don’t you?
I served in the Navy for 10 years, and afterward, I went back to school to become a Nurse Practitioner. It has always been my mission to serve all Americans in the best way possible. Now, as an elected Congresswoman, I’m taking my mission to Capitol Hill.
But the far-Left doesn’t like me. They don’t care about making our nation’s future brighter for ALL Americans...they just care about their own WOKE agendas.
I won't EVER back down from a fight, and not one with so much at stake, but I don’t think I can win this alone.
As I said, I’m not a career politician, so asking for your support isn’t easy for me. But today, I’m humbly asking if you will chip in to support my fight against the far-Left.

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1911, [the first commercial telegram](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGO2zAQAF9DdTJWK51IFyzSqLu0KYU9cmltQJEHciPDvw-cL6QfDAbz63P_JMlSHj_pZK-p7oWfPbMqtz1QoUhKTVLqgUrgdlEIUnYEXEdwI8JOQeXifaEh-sSMPA_sJ-ssIix2Hg5v3brcGe_zl7OTc8lFt8QZltV-AMN9GsS_feAQJgD7ATcbwxTW1c30tc4Yk1mAo2htt99Vih6c8qte3G6hnkP2h-p3N_MPg5vBTQ_pkV5SlMNxSNfaXm_Q4AbO4IZgcEvSuo6hnie3IJRH5cyPRufYuehIrf4pcdSDx2dtORrchubj91Nylr5as8DjJMn_AvQ_v10e_wYAAP__VROCnA) was sent to test how quickly a message could be transmitted around the world. _The New York Times_ initiated the transmission, which traveled over 28,000 miles, relayed by 16 different operators. Remarkably, it arrived back at _The Times_ just 16.5 minutes later. What did people actually do [before the internet](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFurDAQxvHTQAcyA4vZwsVr6Pa1KdEwHi8TeW1kRqDcPtrkCDnA9_uk_8djeaBESc__-GKnIS-JryOyKpeFMKFHxSIhHISJuJxIJGkBA2NjpgbMgqRy8jJg7V1gBu5rdp2dLIAZbF9vbrTdnewA62A9AZqJaO1Ws96Z8BZwrMW9PTOB6YyxN9NaTx2N49TjOvbgQzUY9qK5tJ9Zkm4c4lc-ubSUX3V0m-p-VP2_CuYK5uu6Wt34oJJj5NIm1grmt9zdKph1k_Q8mp3zHrnx4puVQy7c6MaNJOXyO6iL8_slMcox2mowzxdK_DnUP3Y6HXwHAAD__2Y9fZo)? Flipped through the Yellow Pages, called the library to settle a bet, and prayed the vacation photos turned out. Today's _Throwback Thursday_ rounds up the routines we've all but forgotten. Hit reply and tell us what you miss most. Have you ever done a home remodel and regretted it? ## Trump Hits Pause on 50% Canada Tariffs
President Trump paused 50% tariffs on roughly $20 billion in Canadian imports late Tuesday, hours before they took effect, announcing a [last-minute deal](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1urDAQhZ_GdKDx8GMaF7eh29umRLPj8eLEmJVxQPv2EUneIM1pjvQdfeftNt8oxJAe_2kVW_w2Jzn3KKVInpkSOSqUg_c7U2LJBzGHNCPgUMNYI8zEJRwyd1Q560VQ2kqsNqNBhM601WJHox373mkQMK4fNNPIbkAPuhPEvgr24sGIoAFMD41xrHkYxpbuQ4vOqw7EhbLl5n0LqSzi42s7JDe8rVW0SynPXbX_FE4Kp_M8G053vkqF04VWOMGocNJXlPy5PmumnORV_yjWv461E4ohSV0ofuzNUtZYZeueZ4gx7INRHTxWCvF7t_zxrsPiVwAAAP__hJh-cA) with Ottawa. The [three-day pause](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0M9u8yAQBPCnwTcivPgPHDh80idLPaTXHq0NXhIqDBbeOMrbV2n7Bj2PNJrffJznM8YU8_UdV3IcypzpsSdipjp7zLggY40h7B6zp3qg9zHPoGCQykhQM3qOB80dNosLREC6IdeOZgRQ3aibmws2WEPeYLB6ANsbb4F6Y80FdK9haKJ79SkDqlVq7NVpXHzrh8FovAwaliA6RUvkUk-fJWa-UUjPclA9-bI2yd2Yt13ofwImARNe_MvwygRMb5mpZuRYMiYBE9f7uknMudyzp10yrVupWJ9yw_tOMtND_rjlL1zAtHOpT6GnuAj9v9X92Nvemqa6ZXvElOI-jKJT1xVj-p7Ef3zycPAVAAD__4AAiQo) came after Trump's trade talks with Prime Minister Mark Carney. The duties, imposed under a rarely used Depression-era law, would have hit hockey sticks, wine, and other consumer goods over what the administration calls Canadian trade barriers on autos, alcohol, and dairy. Trump also teased reviving the long-dead Keystone XL pipeline, writing it could be "awoken from the grave!" Former President Biden revoked its permits in 2021. Read the [President's post on Truth Social](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu7CAQheGnsbtdDWMbcEFxpSt3mypSSmsCw5oIgwWsV3n7aPMKac-RvuL_uK03CjGk-xvtbJrPa-Jnjdwal9VSIkeNSvC-WkqWy0nWhrQioLyAviCsZFs4eR2pd8YzIw89G6G0QoRRDf1mYBZqYM9COTvPPCiGeQIWDJqd9FMfzMsDjSAA1ARX5aywUuqBPuWAzncjsAstl-tXDqlt7ON3Prlcbd77aLbWjtoN_zpcOlxaebStZhsovv7XOEJhiv9zoujey2M_OlyOXFvtcBFCCTErKfQEE4KcdV-MO54hxlCl6ka47xR-qb79sdBp8CcAAP__KxV4pQ). Neither side has released the deal's terms. Canadian business groups had warned the 50% rate would effectively end many companies' U.S. sales.
## Personalized Cancer Vaccine Passes Major Trial
A personalized melanoma skin cancer vaccine from Moderna and Merck succeeded in its [first late-stage trial](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uxCAQRk-DOyw8dgAXFGncbdqU1iyM1yT8rADZyu0jZ4-Q-pOevvc-b-sNffDp8YGRTNvymuisgVqjslpM6LBh8dtWLSZL5UBrfVpBgORCcxAr2uYPWifsnNmIgMaOzKC0AhCTGrvdoJROKJCDJm1hRi2UA5jGbZ70jA47by6e0CAGIdSb6JWzg5VSj3iXI7iNTYKcb7n0X9mnttMWfvJBpbc5dsHsrT0rG98ZLAyW8zx7m-72GhksF5rBIjSDZZgZLDE7Kgl5pGK_-UuLv7yI1z2flfvkm8fAAzbiteGDeKSAKUfkV5B-bzF0xbjn6UPwVSo2iUdEH_4etX-GPAz8BgAA__-r3Yfi), the companies announced Wednesday, the first mRNA cancer vaccine ever to clear that bar. The made-to-order shot targets the mutations specific to each patient's tumor. Paired with Merck's immunotherapy Keytruda in a trial of more than [1,100 melanoma patients](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGS3CAQBdDToIyppjUDmoDACdk6dahqQ7PCi2ALsFRze5e8R9i8q___79fb-kYpp_L-k3a2I9a18Nkzj8Ft9VQo0KCWYuyeiud2kPeprAioJSwSYSU_0sHrnaZgIzPyPLFVZjGIcDfztFmDqGjRSiteZjIUvX5Eb54BHhy0hynZ6x8sCArAPOBmglde62Wm33rGEMUdOKRR2-1PTWVsHPOrHtxuvu5TttsYn13MPwQ6ge48z9vfTqMGel0HAl0ftb0EumubQLcx5bEJdFesQAeLQKeeAt3OzX_IvQZuhbrcOVOpO8n-kYr8EpBfBCxHS5QFuqeatdFPADAC3dRs-DxTzqlrI-7wvlPK_3uOb_IeFv8FAAD__zNTjTo), it kept the deadliest form of skin cancer from returning or spreading longer than Keytruda alone. The companies expect to begin talks with regulators within months, and the vaccine is already being tested against lung, bladder, and kidney cancers.
## Map: US Growth to 2040 Driven by Two States
A new population projection shows the U.S. will add 21.5 million people by 2040, but more than half that growth will land in just two states: Texas and Florida. Together, they're expected to gain 11.2 million residents. [You can see projections for your state here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OnDAQAJ8GOqNl-b3CRRq6S5sSLfb62MgYhPdA9_bR5RW-fjQjzZ_n_CSJkl6_aWOrYZ8T3zmyKp-zo0SelE4JITtKjs-LnJM0I2BvYDQIMzmVi-eWSm8DM3JTsq2HcUCEdmjK1Xada6CGR9eNvQ_9gu3C46Ojug0DAHMp9uuDEaEGGDqoBu9q1_djQ0vfoA9FC-xF97P6u0vSlUP87Befldu3MtpV9chF86vAqcDpvu_qkvym6OgQpShZv2CB00bHwd7Qxqc4yubYj3cklT0Zt1J6sVk-JispG4QWCpzK0_rjlhgl90PRwmsjif-z-sNbl8V_AQAA__9FVn_7). On the flip side, 14 states are projected to lose population. Illinois leads the decline at nearly 650,000, followed by New York at 457,000. California, which grew every decade of the last century, is also expected to shrink. The South is expected to account for the majority of growth, as [deaths now outnumber births in 17 states](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFutDAQBOCngc7ILBzmL1z8Dd2lTYkWe31sZAyy90B5-4i8QtpPoxlpPp_zEzlyen3gRlbCPie6SiQRyrPDhB4FM4dQHCZH-UTnOM2gYVB6VKBndMInzT3W3gYioK4m25rRAOjedPVqCRAwkHugMbg8RtMOixn-wXKzC23N9u7TI-hWa_PQjfGudcMwdrgMHfhQ9Zo8y56br52TrBTi935Sbty-1dGuIkepuv8VTBVM13U1J5c3RocHC0YucgcrmDY8DvLKE8paVNovtb8lvbeFslo438hJtUYVQaFSwVRn64-LY-QymKrXrw05_s7KH986LfwEAAD__5w9gZQ) and replacement migration tilts heavily toward warmer, cheaper regions.

A few months ago, with no press release, xAI bought the site of a shuttered Duke Energy plant in Southaven, Mississippi.

Musk’s supercomputer runs on temporary turbines that a federal permit shuts off on January 2.

Now.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: This goal isn’t arbitrary
body:
Let me explain why your support is so important.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1154&source=&t=1&akid=2855%2E124072%2ENSbKM_)
| | | |
---
Peter,
Today, I’m asking you to make your first donation to my Senate campaign in North Carolina. If that’s all you need to hear, you can use this link to chip in:
[**_https:/ /secure.actblue.com/cooper/email_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1154&amount=5&t=8&akid=2855%2E124072%2ENSbKM_)
Otherwise, let me explain why your support is so important.
By giving $5 (or whatever amount you can), you’ll join the hundreds of thousands of people who have pitched in to claim a stake in our grassroots movement.
By giving $5, you’ll be saying that you refuse to let the GOP buy this seat for President Trump’s handpicked candidate, former Big Oil and utility company lobbyist Michael Whatley – and that you’re ready to fight back against the nearly $100 million in attack ad spending that Republicans have poured into this race so far.
By giving $5, you’ll help us reach today's fundraising goal.
This goal isn’t arbitrary, Peter. | **It’s what my team has calculated we need to keep pace with the GOP – and if we come up short, we will put our chances of flipping this seat at risk.**
I know that not everyone can chip in to every email we send. I’m hoping I can count on you to donate to this one.
[**_Will you chip in your first contribution of $5 to help us meet our goal, win in North Carolina and take back the Senate?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1154&amount=5&t=9&akid=2855%2E124072%2ENSbKM_)

---

Roy Cooper
_If you've donated via check, mail or in-person event, thank you! Our system may not have processed your gift yet, but rest assured, we have received it. Please note, if you have given through a spouse or another email or phone number, our records may not have transferred that information here. We are grateful for your support and no further action is required at this time._
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1154&t=2&akid=2855%2E124072%2ENSbKM_)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

[**_Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1154&source=&t=3&akid=2855%2E124072%2ENSbKM_)

subject: 🎙️NEW EPISODE: Tennessee’s Reproductive Healthcare Crisis feat. Rachel Wells
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF GLORIA JOHNSON, LISA SORENSEN, TREASURER
body:
I sat down with Rachel Wells, independent journalist and founder of TN Repro News, to talk about what's really happening to repro healthcare in TN

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/fba3ad20214e/stand-up-against-the-shameful-gop-power-grab-7363829?e=dc5f639d62)

Hey friends,
This week I sat down with [Rachel Wells](https://us.list-manage.com/vRoQAa0zvss?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0), independent journalist and founder of [TN Repro News](https://us.list-manage.com/2HDLUqyJWbU?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0), to talk about what's really happening to reproductive healthcare in Tennessee—and it goes well beyond the headlines.

CLICK HERE to[ LISTEN NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/10EEoG7oWAH?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)

If you want to **stay informed** on this issue, subscribe to Rachel's newsletter, TN Repro News: [https://wellsrachelm.substack.com/](https://us.list-manage.com/pw5dxrOiG3K?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)
#### [**Listen or watch**](https://us.list-manage.com/gAin7m7i1s9?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)**now wherever you get your podcasts. 🎧**

Thank you for being here,Gloria

ALSO HAPPENING THIS WEEK in NASHVILLE...

**Join the conversation:** Saturday, August 22nd11:30 AM - 1 PM📍 David Lusk Gallery | 516 Hagan St., Nashville _**Face in the Thorns:**_ Rachel Wells of TN Repro News joins artist Tess Davies and Francie Hunt of Tennessee Advocates for Planned Parenthood for a conversation exploring art as a reflection of autonomy and resistance. _****_
We get into real patient stories, including a Tennessee woman who was denied prenatal care and had to cross into Virginia to receive care—simply because she was unmarried. We talk about the crisis pregnancy centers now permitted to be the _only_ organizations teaching sex education in our schools, and we also dig into the maternal mortality crisis driven by rural hospital closures (nearly 60% of Tennessee counties don't have an OB or maternal care at their local hospital).
You can hear more from Rachel Wells in Nashville this Saturday, August 22, at ‘Face in the Thorns,’ an Artist x Activist conversation during the 2nd annual [pARTisan exhibition](https://us.list-manage.com/14nz8YAdOro?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0).

body:
We cannot give up or act guilty for demanding our rights and exercising our freedoms. This is America, not Russia.
| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LsOIWDgsAftP9zKGlgBig9T_t-ycsw7ubC6AW757h2CfF25n_LHlGXdBk2q2QktRNcr_tlTMq2cd9eGlzv8WtC8RGWrdaA1GL_D521f620LKaimvg1x3R_9qzGP_INVEj8vjOWBWzthbyOy4Refyq2uwuHoh6eX34GfD_FQ8a9AaYnvdkIlprL9Y07-lXxOI2W3WVz8XxNjhUNbH7XrgsNyHziYWqiMRCNTGz0U6k5Y=&c=CNd7s2KGGhz-ojQwCdXer2tFrq-qAJfymPqSkGq8YYGaB5nfUcppSA==&ch=qvLSaI3ScZ-FkVa_XgrQk9nTwxUhCDp02JevoyiXuiSTA8Cy3jx6Iw==)
---
|
Peter,
The FBI had battering rams and guns at the ready when they raided the offices of the progressive Ohio Organizing Collaborative.
They detained workers there for hours, subjecting them to interrogation without counsel present.
According to the group's leadership, they also questioned volunteers and even their underage children at their homes -- clear acts of intimidation to scare the organization's members from standing up to the Trump regime.
Ohio Organizing Collaborative registers voters and builds collective power to fight for criminal justice reform, racial justice and an expansion of voting rights. They focus on major cities in Ohio, areas that typically support Democrats.
It's no wonder why the FBI put on a show with their chilling raid of OCC.
But here's the twist, and a beacon of hope in the utter darkness of Trump's authoritarian regime: the leaders of OCC didn't just accept their fate and give up. Within 24 hours, they went public with what happened and created the "Hands Off Ohio" campaign to fight back, tell their story, and warn similar groups of more displays of intimidation to come.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LsOIWDgsAftP9zKGlgBig9T_t-ycsw7ubC6AW757h2CfF25n_LHlGXdBk2q2QktRNcr_tlTMq2cd9eGlzv8WtC8RGWrdaA1GL_D521f620LKaimvg1x3R_9qzGP_INVEj8vjOWBWzthbyOy4Refyq2uwuHoh6eX34GfD_FQ8a9AaYnvdkIlprL9Y07-lXxOI2W3WVz8XxNjhUNbH7XrgsA6TDBShLn35ogve5cWvxs8=&c=CNd7s2KGGhz-ojQwCdXer2tFrq-qAJfymPqSkGq8YYGaB5nfUcppSA==&ch=qvLSaI3ScZ-FkVa_XgrQk9nTwxUhCDp02JevoyiXuiSTA8Cy3jx6Iw==)
---
Trump is launching preemptive attacks on our freedom to vote, our First Amendment guarantee to free speech and free assembly, and the foundation of our Constitution.
They know they are going to lose in November. The only way they can survive the reckoning headed their way is to cheat and suppress the opposition. Their tactics are only getting more desperate--but they are also becoming more dangerous.
What we cannot do is hide. We cannot act guilty just for demanding our rights and exercising our freedoms. This is America, not Russia.
At Defend Our Courts, we are inspired by the strength and courage of the Ohio Organizing Collaborative and other groups like it that have stood tall against the Trump regime's abuses of power. We are working to fight back by building a firewall of state Supreme Courts with the power to protect free and fair elections state by state. And we are helping build the momentum to reclaim a US Supreme Court that has made itself an arm of the Trump administration.

This sponsored message from Inside Scoop Politics is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcuK3DAQRb9G3tnIJbXlXngR8HiVmZAHzNIoqrK7iGwJPXqYvw8dJvmALKvO5cDlvj6vz5Y9n_uLPWjinFcMuNq3kH6FrZ65pmhzJvxJtpb3FSQMrRxbkKt1he-0atvgdIF-3MaGpt6MBsDo4drcJnJWaedGq64o9bhpo68a5Kg2hRenoeHp4ZMjyB6khqED5wYJYMho228GhJY1oi3U8ZkZKbsQYgyeC7vchbQ3frqVErNQnwQsApZMribC7sbeZ7SeOsIqYPl3C1jQ3hnbXEJ6b_GOQi21HKuzR7S8n0LNfwLrA8HwQDnU5EioOaaQI7nC5_6BDkKuh1AzHZb9x9OFs9BZhJq_mvb1x7f2b00BQ3ZCzVJqo18kaPjcX-Yv89PT9yZNGN_Ye86DEVruD1_nwtGU_5zlPsHvAAAA__9DC51W)

| | Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who killed Goliath, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons. King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others? Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel. **This beautiful course is now available on DVD. You can reserve your copy using this secure link:** [https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcuK3DAQRb9G3tnIJbXlXngR8HiVmZAHzNIoqrK7iGwJPXqYvw8dJvmALKvO5cDlvj6vz5Y9n_uLPWjinFcMuNq3kH6FrZ65pmhzJvxJtpb3FSQMrRxbkKt1he-0atvgdIF-3MaGpt6MBsDo4drcJnJWaedGq64o9bhpo68a5Kg2hRenoeHp4ZMjyB6khqED5wYJYMho228GhJY1oi3U8ZkZKbsQYgyeC7vchbQ3frqVErNQnwQsApZMribC7sbeZ7SeOsIqYPl3C1jQ3hnbXEJ6b_GOQi21HKuzR7S8n0LNfwLrA8HwQDnU5EioOaaQI7nC5_6BDkKuh1AzHZb9x9OFs9BZhJq_mvb1x7f2b00BQ3ZCzVJqo18kaPjcX-Yv89PT9yZNGN_Ye86DEVruD1_nwtGU_5zlPsHvAAAA__9DC51W) By taking this course, you’ll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you’ll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you’ll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.** Let’s learn what truly matters in life by studying **“The David Story.”**
Happy learning,
Bill Gray ‘01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

That flag represents everything those colonists risked to build: self-governance, individual freedom, the rule of law. **Which flag are you going to raise?** The radical Left wants you to believe that America's founding principles are outdated. That our history is shameful. That our values should take a back seat to every other culture and ideology. They're wrong. The Heritage Foundation exists to defend the principles that made America the freest, most prosperous nation in history. We fight for you. That is why PreBorn! is working to reach her before abortion does.

| | | | [](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckcGOnDAMhp8m3GYUHAhw4LAqor1sta2q9oiCY8DakKAkzKpvX001I_Xc4__Z-iT7__U6vRp27NevZqc-5mWKaUobfZiUKHI4k_uNwSe2FNlPIEFfZHsBORnMfKOpLmxv0ZoSC-rLpm0AOlmrYust1nW3mBnKxqBBrXSNXaMVEVWVnXXB_V0nW5AlKFnLK6I10HZz2S0L1XMnKmkcxXyNdJyzYzQ-m_S-hIh0xbAXrt9yPpJQLwJGAePKN_br9Yg0h-jvKwLGRxIw4kb4Hs4sYDR4bLIF7YQak1DDy6e3L_f8-U2ARrMfhlcv1FAp6BolQJ95n1I4I5JQwxFDOggz-_Ux2snyuQs10G7YPeA_nhumJww-k89CDepnOX1rLt9_jJfnI4rY2-ODneOkG1HJ9W77e2r-v3JuPfwJAAD___2ln2o)
---
Dear Friend of Life, **“When I first found out I was pregnant, it was probably the scariest thing in the world.”** Those are Sonya’s words. **“It’s one of those moments where you don’t know where to turn or what to do.”** Sonya was seriously considering abortion. But by God’s grace, PreBorn! met her in that frightening moment with compassion and support. And during an ultrasound, she had the opportunity to hear her baby’s heartbeat. **“Hearing my baby’s heartbeat is beautiful,”** she said. Sonya ultimately chose to embrace motherhood. Friend of Life, somewhere today, another woman is experiencing the fear Sonya remembers so clearly. But increasingly, that woman may never walk through the doors of a pregnancy clinic on her own. **She may reach for her phone instead.** Today, approximately 70% of abortions happen through abortion pills. A frightened woman can go online, find an abortion provider, and obtain pills to end her pregnancy without ever setting foot inside an abortion facility. That is why PreBorn! is working to reach her **before abortion does.** PreBorn! is a Christian ministry dedicated to saving babies from abortion and seeing lives transformed through the gospel of Jesus Christ. Through our Virtual Care System, we can reach women looking online for answers and create opportunities for them to connect with registered nurses who care about both mother and baby. A nurse can listen to what she is facing, answer her questions, help identify the pressures influencing her decision, and connect her with a local PreBorn! Network Clinic for an ultrasound and continued support. When welcomed, she can also pray with the mother and offer her the hope of Jesus Christ. **Think about what could happen if we reach the next Sonya first.** Instead of finding only an abortion provider, she can find someone who cares. Instead of making a life-altering decision alone, she can receive compassionate support. And instead of ending the life of her baby, she can have the opportunity to see her child on an ultrasound and discover another path forward. **[Right now, our goal is to reach 500 women facing unexpected pregnancies by August 31.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckcGOnDAMhp8m3GYUHAhw4LAqor1sta2q9oiCY8DakKAkzKpvX001I_Xc4__Z-iT7__U6vRp27NevZqc-5mWKaUobfZiUKHI4k_uNwSe2FNlPIEFfZHsBORnMfKOpLmxv0ZoSC-rLpm0AOlmrYust1nW3mBnKxqBBrXSNXaMVEVWVnXXB_V0nW5AlKFnLK6I10HZz2S0L1XMnKmkcxXyNdJyzYzQ-m_S-hIh0xbAXrt9yPpJQLwJGAePKN_br9Yg0h-jvKwLGRxIw4kb4Hs4sYDR4bLIF7YQak1DDy6e3L_f8-U2ARrMfhlcv1FAp6BolQJ95n1I4I5JQwxFDOggz-_Ux2snyuQs10G7YPeA_nhumJww-k89CDepnOX1rLt9_jJfnI4rY2-ODneOkG1HJ9W77e2r-v3JuPfwJAAD___2ln2o)** Will you help us reach the next one?

clean_body: That is why PreBorn! is working to reach her before abortion does. | | | | Dear Friend of Life, “When I first found out I was pregnant, it was probably the scariest thing in the world.” Those are Sonya’s words. “It’s one of those moments where you don’t know where to turn or what to do.” Sonya was seriously considering abortion. But by God’s grace, PreBorn! met her in that frightening moment with compassion and support. And during an ultrasound, she had the opportunity to hear her baby’s heartbeat. “Hearing my baby’s heartbeat is beautiful,” she said. Sonya ultimately chose to embrace motherhood. Friend of Life, somewhere today, another woman is experiencing the fear Sonya remembers so clearly. But increasingly, that woman may never walk through the doors of a pregnancy clinic on her own. She may reach for her phone instead. Today, approximately 70% of abortions happen through abortion pills. A frightened woman can go online, find an abortion provider, and obtain pills to end her pregnancy without ever setting foot inside an abortion facility. That is why PreBorn! is working to reach her before abortion does. PreBorn! is a Christian ministry dedicated to saving babies from abortion and seeing lives transformed through the gospel of Jesus Christ. Through our Virtual Care System, we can reach women looking online for answers and create opportunities for them to connect with registered nurses who care about both mother and baby. A nurse can listen to what she is facing, answer her questions, help identify the pressures influencing her decision, and connect her with a local PreBorn! Network Clinic for an ultrasound and continued support. When welcomed, she can also pray with the mother and offer her the hope of Jesus Christ. Think about what could happen if we reach the next Sonya first. Instead of finding only an abortion provider, she can find someone who cares. Instead of making a life-altering decision alone, she can receive compassionate support. And instead of ending the life of her baby, she can have the opportunity to see her child on an ultrasound and discover another path forward. Will you help us reach the next one? Your gift of $25, $50, $100, $200, or any amount can help put life-affirming hope in the path of a frightened mother looking online for answers. The next woman may be sitting alone right now, feeling exactly what Sonya felt: Scared. Unsure where to turn. Wondering what to do. Before abortion becomes her answer, help us reach her with hope. Thank you for giving mothers like Sonya the opportunity to see their babies, choose life, and encounter the hope of Jesus Christ. For Life, The PreBorn! | | **Tankers Operated by Abu Dhabi National Oil Company Were Struck in Hormuz and a Saudi Aramco Refinery Was Attacked, Driving Oil Up 5% and Brent Back to $89. Here Is Why Striking the Gulf’s State Energy Champions Revives the Acute-Supply Tail.**
---
| | The conflict escalated materially with direct attacks on physical energy infrastructure this week: tankers operated by the Abu Dhabi National Oil Company were struck in the Strait of Hormuz, and a Saudi Aramco refinery was attacked. **These strikes, which helped drive Brent and WTI up more than 5% last week, mark a significant escalation because they target the Gulf’s state oil companies directly — the crown jewels of the region’s energy infrastructure — rather than the anonymous shadow-fleet tankers that had absorbed most of the earlier risk.** Brent has climbed back to around $89.
---
| | For your portfolio, the targeting of ADNOC tankers and an Aramco refinery is a qualitative shift in the risk profile. For months the attacks focused on shipping and transit; striking the physical assets of Abu Dhabi and Saudi Arabia — the two anchor Gulf producers and key US partners — raises the stakes considerably. **As Priyanka Sachdeva of Phillip Nova put it, oil has now rebounded almost completely from the early-August lows as hopes for a permanent US-Iran resolution have faded and geopolitical risk premiums have returned.** For the American investor at or near retirement, the escalation reintroduces the acute-supply-risk tail the market had grown comfortable discounting. The comfortable base case — chronic but contained, oil range-bound in the mid-to-high $80s — rested partly on the assumption that production infrastructure would stay intact. A successful strike that took significant Gulf production or refining offline would move the market toward the acute-shortage scenario that drove Brent above $126 in spring. The $90 defensive trigger is now in close view. Maintain the energy and inflation hedges and watch for further infrastructure attacks as the key escalation signal.
---

Hello Friends & Neighbors! **Today officially marks the beginning of early voting for the Democratic primary**. Not sure where in the world you will be on September 9th? Head to the city or town hall where you are registered to vote (you can check this at [vote.sos.ri.gov](https://sue4ri.com/l/zbZCXlh5iItL)) during regular business hours to cast your ballot today! With only a few short weeks left until the primary, we've been keeping busy. Here's a look at what we've been up to recently:
---
|
---
**Recent Updates:**
---
**My comprehensive energy plan is live!** Thank you to everyone who joined us at the State House last week to announce the official launch of "[New Energy for Rhode Island: Putting the Power Back in Our Hands!](https://sue4ri.com/l/lxHcQBB2h9FP)" I am so grateful to Jeff Migneault, Executive Director of Climate Action Rhode Island, former RI State Representative Aaron Regunberg, and Representatives Teresa Tanzi, Rebecca Kislak, Jennifer Boylan, and Jennifer Stewart for standing alongside me for this powerful moment (and to many more in support who couldn't make it on Thursday).

We have to flip Ohio to have any chance of taking back the Senate. Everyone counted us out, but we’re proving the naysayers wrong at every step. This is now the most important Senate race in the country – but if we’re going to win it, I need your help. Please. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = It’s not an overstatement to say that what happens in Ohio will shape our nation’s future. I’m grateful for and inspired by the hundreds of thousands of folks who have stood by my side in this fight. Sherrod Brown | | Note: This email only reflects donations made online with this email address. If you've made a previous contribution via check or with a different email address/phone number, you may not see it here – but know that Sherrod and our entire team are deeply grateful for your support. = Hey there! It's Sherrod Brown. There's nobody fighting for Ohioans in the U.S. Senate right now, and I won't sit on the sidelines while working people get screwed over by large corporations and wealthy political donors. If you work hard, you should be able to afford a decent life. But the reality is, life is too expensive. Costs are going up. Wages are staying stagnant. Working people are working harder than ever before, and they're not getting their share of the profit. This campaign is all about changing that – and election analysts say we have a strong shot at winning in November. But I'll need your help to pull it off: My opponent is a Washington insider being propped up by the Republican establishment, and he's got virtually unlimited resources. That's not how our campaign works. We're a grassroots movement, and that means we rely on ordinary people chipping in a couple bucks. =** If you'd like to receive exclusive updates from my team, you can text "OHIO" to 64054. I grew up in Donora, where people worked hard, looked out for their neighbors, and believed that if you put in an honest day's work, you deserved an honest day's pay. That's still what I believe. I believe hard work should be rewarded. I believe we should make things in America again, bring good-paying jobs back to communities that have been left behind, and rebuild small-town America. I believe Social Security and Medicare are promises we've made to our seniors. And I believe government should work for working people—not corporations, billionaires, or political insiders. Those aren't values I discovered when I decided to run for office. They've guided me throughout my life—from serving as an Army officer and helicopter pilot during Desert Storm to spending twenty years as an FBI Special Agent. Now I'm running for Congress, and I'm doing something I believe every representative should do: showing up. I've traveled across PA-14 holding town halls, knocking on doors, attending community events, and listening to Republicans, Democrats, Independents, and people who don't consider themselves political at all. And there's one question I keep hearing: "Where's Guy?" People tell me they rarely see their Congressman. I intend to represent this district differently. If I'm asking for your vote, you deserve to look me in the eye and ask me a question—and that shouldn't change after Election Day. I also believe we need more accountability in Washington. I support term limits, I believe members of Congress should be banned from trading individual stocks, and I don't accept corporate PAC money. Congress should be public service—not a career or an opportunity to cash in. clean_body: Guided me throughout my life, from serving as an Army officer and helicopter pilot during Desert Storm to spending twenty years as an FBI Special Agent | Friends, I sometimes tell people that I'm my grandfather's Democrat. I grew up in Donora, where people worked hard, looked out for their neighbors, and believed that if you put in an honest day's work, you deserved an honest day's pay. That's still what I believe. I believe hard work should be rewarded. I believe we should make things in America again, bring good-paying jobs back to communities that have been left behind, and rebuild small-town America. I believe Social Security and Medicare are promises we've made to our seniors. And I believe government should work for working people—not corporations, billionaires, or political insiders. If you've saved your payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately. Those aren't values I discovered when I decided to run for office. They've guided me throughout my life—from serving as an Army officer and helicopter pilot during Desert Storm to spending twenty years as an FBI Special Agent. Now I'm running for Congress, and I'm doing something I believe every representative should do: showing up. I've traveled across PA-14 holding town halls, knocking on doors, attending community events, and listening to Republicans, Democrats, Independents, and people who don't consider themselves political at all. And there's one question I keep hearing: "Where's Guy?" People tell me they rarely see their Congressman. I intend to represent this district differently. If I'm asking for your vote, you deserve to look me in the eye and ask me a question—and that shouldn't change after Election Day. I also believe we need more accountability in Washington. I support term limits, I believe members of Congress should be banned from trading individual stocks, and I don't accept corporate PAC money. Congress should be public service—not a career or an opportunity to cash in. After a lifetime of serving this country, I'm not done serving yet. Sincerely, Alan Bradstock MAGA loyalist Guy Reschenthaler has consistently put party loyalty and corporate interests ahead of working families in our district. It’s time for real leadership that puts people first. Democrat Alan Bradstock is stepping up to fight for affordable healthcare, reproductive freedom, workers’ rights, and a stronger democracy, but he can’t do it without your support. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. Arresting me alongside President Trump as innocent men.
Freezing my bank accounts.
Seizing my assets.
Forcing me to the point of bankruptcy._
---
**And now, a vengeful Democrat Attorney General making me stand in a rigged trial for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that not even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – can save me with a _federal_ pardon in _state_ court.**
---
The lunatic Left's desire to DESTROY yours truly knows no bounds.
---
They even stripped me of my law licenses so I would have no means to defend myself, leading pundits in the media to label me a **“ _DEAD_ _MAN_ _WALKING_!”**
---
But what I've come to realize ever since I came so close to death was that the pursuit of truth, freedom, and justice are worth infinitely more than any earthly possession.
---
**They can strip me of all I'm worth – _all I'll ever be worth_ – but what I _REFUSE_ to surrender to the Democrats and their Deep State thugs is my LEGACY!**

And __that__ is what my final trial is truly all about, Friend.

**I'd rather lose everything than betray what I know to be true. I could never lie and say what I'm going through is a fair and honest process just to hang on to “earthly possessions.”**
---
"__For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?_ " (Mark 8:36)_
---
You see, this FINAL BATTLE for my freedom is about ensuring this injustice can _NEVER_ _AGAIN_ happen to another innocent patriot all for standing by what he knows to be right and true.
---
I pray to God that will be my legacy when we win this trial.
---
But now, as I fight with all I've got, I have only one place left to turn to help me reach the finish line and secure my freedom: _good and honest Americans like _YOU__.
---
Friend, I understand this was probably the last thing on your mind today. I get it. And that's why I always say that if you can't afford to help me in this fight, please delete this message and carry on with your day. Don't even think twice about it.

_**But if you can help, I'm going to need the best defense I can get to defeat this radical Democrat Attorney General who is hell-bent on locking me up for the rest of my life.**_

---

Right now, too many families and working people across North Carolina are struggling to pay the increasing amount it takes to keep a roof over their heads.
Affording a decent place to live has become a challenge, and I'm hearing about it most everywhere I go. I've talked with young people who are transitioning from home or college to the workforce and looking for their first apartment, only to find rent prices that are out of control and still climbing.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/c1c79477-67d1-48ba-ba6c-76bdfc07874e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I spoke to Jarrod in Greensboro, where he recently graduated from NC A&T and is excited about his new job. But like a lot of people his age, the high cost of housing is weighing on his mind. He told me that finding something affordable close to work, particularly with the high gas prices, has felt extremely difficult.
Jarrod has spent most of his childhood here in North Carolina, and plans on staying in the state and moving to Charlotte for work. But he told me that he's not sure he'll ever be able to afford a home the way his parents could.
And it's not just young people feeling this burden. I've heard from folks who've spent years working hard, providing for their families and saving every chance they get. But home ownership is still simply out of reach for them no matter how hard they try.
[If that's all you need to hear, please chip in $5, or whatever you can, to help us win in North Carolina, take back the Senate and fight for affordable housing.](https://substack.com/redirect/c1c79477-67d1-48ba-ba6c-76bdfc07874e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
That's why as Attorney General I negotiated hundreds of millions of dollars in mortgage relief for North Carolinians and cracked down on corporations that inflated home values and trapped North Carolinians in mortgages they could not afford. I took on predatory lenders and stood up for thousands of homeowners facing illegal foreclosure.
As Governor, I prioritized expanding affordable housing and proposed budgets that helped first-time home buyers with down payments. I vetoed bills that made it harder for low-income families, the elderly and people with disabilities to find affordable rental housing. And I awarded more than $355 million in community grants to our local governments to help rural communities and revitalize neighborhoods across the state.
But this work is far from over, and we have a long way to go before buying a house feels in reach for millions of working families. As a U.S. Senator, I'll keep working to make housing cost less.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/c1c79477-67d1-48ba-ba6c-76bdfc07874e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
All across the state, people keep asking me the same question: why is this so much harder than it used to be and how do we fix it?
Here's my plan:
**Support Building More Homes**
That means we have to build faster and smarter to keep up with rising demand, including more incentives to build multi-family and modular homes. If we can have more homes on the market it will help lower housing costs for folks across the state.
**Eliminate Unnecessary Rules That Drive Up Housing Costs**
Another part of the problem comes back to the unnecessary rules and regulations standing in the way between families and the homes they need. If we can cut back on the redundant steps in the review process and modernize outdated permitting systems, we can drive down costs for everyone.
**End Tariffs Driving Up Prices for Building Materials**
We're also seeing how the chaotic, erratic tariffs coming out of Washington DC are exacerbating our housing crisis. Trump's tariffs have driven up the price of lumber, steel and aluminum, adding thousands of dollars to the cost of construction for a home. We need people in Washington willing to fight to roll back these reckless tariffs and ease some of the burden on home construction that's hurting North Carolina working families.
**Stop Big Corporations, Investment Funds and Foreign Companies from Buying Single-Family Homes.**
We need to restrict big corporate buyers from owning large portfolios of single-family homes that drive up prices for families trying to buy a home.
**Ban Algorithm-Driven Rent Setting.**
This housing crisis isn't just about buying -- we have to make it easier to rent, too.
Right now, too many corporate landlords are sharing your data with each other to coordinate rent hikes, squeezing renters who already have few options. That's just wrong. We need to crack down on these bad actors who are willing to profit off working people trying to keep a roof over their heads.

* * *
But at the end of the day, this fight isn't just about policy -- it's about protecting what makes North Carolina so special. One of the things I love most about this state is how proud people are to live and work here. No matter where you go, people love their communities and the places they call home. Their hard work has instilled that pride and they deserve a place to live that's safe for their families and doesn't break their budget.
When I get to Washington, I'm going to fight to roll back Trump's reckless tariffs and help put an end to the housing crisis that is hurting families across the state and our country.
I'm ready to be an independent voice for North Carolina, focused on the stuff that really matters to people. That starts with making sure people can afford a roof over their heads.
Thank you for reading.

Peter,
The Senate is calling their 5-year Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) plan a "ban." _**But the truth is, it isn't.**_

First, understand what's actually at stake. A __[_**CBDC**_](http://links.redconservatives.com/s/c/Qm8RYwcROnvHmJlTm64UqR5qK-2GcbqjWsPv1hwEbwdVpIGBwVoPiHpENSI4escPDgZ6mJMewaUfrIG3_ZvR7Z5i93uFcHuhVyMQsdRXdxhJXeU9yv1fpZQV-j46g0PQWApKX6ConkBl3UD_L2wDREbJsHndSjunUA-qRm-WMXvk473yNpq5GQL_kcu4-Zy_BHURZEt6FbK7KYaum1O_YbQT2NV44KEccF3QAWWRgh3HIy5pJSNIxJmiRUeAYEMCwdmCARUQ1mLV_4o7u40ATZIS0ymkiXkm7Yt6ojgIrj2rJjm-3tLRljFj14Rochv4_cxBB7yG2qft-40rajFOmTNIMCD5QrdNGrq2C-8GZYwTqUsrDWk-v8nLPgojtf6db8L83u0V_CE1Em-VLHje12Uk5f93f4sxrlMdgODS3J6sw3iXxaMjt7OCiC98A9R06ySf6fzVKpTwHiJXwRoZHvpU0TPBBpDc7z4Zch6c2QCKOcr0W1VqjLa6zYqyPc_qgGGDVZDKwbwARyTNoCPhLE-2xVYvC78PbVR5uRpZskNHGSmHP6Sy8-cBKzCga0AnBfFlsoXvZYjl2A8cCbfO5on268iFV07_D9NiW4Ugb2mb11KRvdlIKoCWsdNAKV-5tyBoulEYryyM37x5FRJAPJT_sjhvqMf0b2W1eUhEOlYk0oLpCRGMJGmdm0J8hFFa-fW8/dXLW_PFZjm4FsXp1y2LiYPAH1Ax6GgA3/23) is a government-controlled, programmable digital dollar -- one that **lets Deep State bureaucrats track every purchase you make,** block transactions they disapprove of, and freeze accounts at will.

**The Deep State doesn't sit idle -- they build. In 5 years, this Communist infrastructure could already be in place. And dismantling something already built is far harder than preventing it from being built in the first place.**

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. Medi-Cal coverage.
Civil rights protections.

* * *
# **Democrats ' phony working-class campaign narratives exposed**
Several battleground Democrats have built campaigns around blue-collar biographies, but records reviewed by Fox News Digital **[tell a very different story.](https://substack.com/redirect/2c04f139-bc6d-49da-a257-583d7e616fe1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2c04f139-bc6d-49da-a257-583d7e616fe1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **New Jersey candidate Rebecca Bennett reported nearly $250,000 in 2024 salary** and assets up to $1.8 million despite emphasizing financial struggles, while campaign funds have covered her childcare costs.
* **Rep. Gabe Vasquez (D-N.M.) has described his mother 's factory work in Mexico, **though records show she held senior GE finance roles, alongside social media showing international travel and luxury shopping; his campaign defended her story as one of hard-won success.
* **Rep. Marie Gluesenkamp Perez (D-Wash.) has cited working three jobs** to pay Reed College tuition and her hands-on trades background, but former classmates and a past business bio have raised questions about both claims, which her campaign disputes. **[The Washington Free Beacon reported](https://substack.com/redirect/33e32d0d-9d78-4c8c-a17d-70de7128a39c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** she worked "mostly behind the scenes managing the business side" of her auto shop, which was reportedly cited for multiple workplace-safety violations in 2017 via an OSHA inspection.

* * *
# **Study: Top news aggregators favor outlets with all-Democratic endorsement records**
The Media Research Center found that the most-featured outlets on Apple News and Google News **[have endorsed Democratic presidential candidates](https://substack.com/redirect/ae7523e0-8109-480c-a9cd-530f05ee31f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** a combined 55 times since 1988, with zero Republican endorsements -- including the New York Times' unbroken streak of Democratic endorsements dating to 1988.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ae7523e0-8109-480c-a9cd-530f05ee31f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Microsoft 's MSN showed a similar pattern,** with just two Republican endorsements out of 27 total among its most-featured outlets, both from the San Francisco Chronicle in 1988 and 1992. MRC president David Bozell argued the pattern reflects a systemic bias in how these platforms surface news.
* **Google disputed MRC 's methodology,** while Apple and Microsoft didn't respond to requests for comment. The findings follow a February FTC warning letter to Apple over similar bias claims and an April AllSides study finding aggregators draw minimal content from right-leaning outlets.

Now he’s put it to work for what it _all_ comes down to for this President: using his position of power to enrich himself.

Look at this headline:

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137579959/641272921/1104136256?refcode=260820em_tk_trumpswealth&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDQvMS84ODkyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZGQ4ZTc5ZS1hMzljLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MA72SbFQZ8b4uZSSQt4QVkyODIftljy_kvCH67HhXXU=)

A deranged 6:00 AM Truth Social post from Trump can move financial markets around the globe, and for $100,000, an elite few can now access that information before the rest of the world.
_It’s clear and blatant corruption. _
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137579960/641272922/1104136256?refcode=260820em_tk_trumpswealth&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDQvMS84ODkyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZGQ4ZTc5ZS1hMzljLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MA72SbFQZ8b4uZSSQt4QVkyODIftljy_kvCH67HhXXU=)
