* * *
Everything I have learned about Donald Trump's bizarre relationship with White House aide Natalie Harp has been against my will. Every new story raises more questions than it answers -- and at minimum, what we're looking at sure seems like an emotional affair between the President of the United States and a taxpayer-funded staffer nearly fifty years his junior.
When I shot a YouTube video about this yesterday, I blurted out something that stuck with me: Donald Trump can't even have a normal affair like a typical politician. It has to be some of the weirdest shit you've ever heard.
Consider what we actually know about Natalie Harp. She's a true believer -- a former OAN anchor who has swallowed every lie Trump has ever told. According to her own brother, she has a history of obsessing over Republican presidents and writing them love letters. She writes Trump love letters now. She sleeps on a cot in a locker room at Mar-a-Lago. She once got into a shouting match with the Secret Service because there wasn't room for her in the back of an SUV -- so she climbed into the trunk like a little kid. For a long stretch, she didn't even have a security clearance, making her a national security incident waiting to happen. She follows him around like a sad little puppy dog.
And when Trump abandoned Marco Rubio on Air Force One because he was worried Iran might assassinate him, he made damn sure to take Natalie Harp with him.
I don't know the true nature of their relationship. Maybe none of us ever will. Some people think her job is changing the man's diapers. Others think it's a physical affair. **And frankly, whether they're actually sleeping together isn't the most important question here.** I don't know. What I do know is how the White House has responded -- and that tells you everything.
This conversation was kickstarted by Senator Jon Ossoff, who casually dropped Natalie's name into the middle of a speech this weekend -- a brilliant Easter egg for the media to become obsessed with. **But the Harp reference wasn't really the point.** Ossoff's actual point was simple: Donald Trump is focused on anything other than doing his job. He'd rather golf, jet around the world, slap his name on shit, and yammer about his ballroom than do a single thing that might improve your life -- end the illegal war in Iran, get gas prices back down, or make sure our sailors have enough food and provisions on these record-long deployments.
And every single time a MAGA hack or a White House staffer lashes out at Ossoff, or pushes back against the now-numerous leaks about Natalie Harp, they prove his point. They care more about this than they care about you. You are their boss. Donald Trump works for you. Natalie Harp works for you. She's an adult and a taxpayer-funded staffer, and it is perfectly reasonable to ask questions about her relationship with the president when she appears to be a threat to our national security and our domestic tranquility. **Not because the gossip is salacious, but because her extraordinary access and influence raise legitimate questions about who has power inside this White House.**
Because set aside the weirdness for a second. Natalie Harp is the person who feeds Donald Trump his information. She's his "human printer." She shapes the worldview of the President of the United States. She's the one who allegedly posted the racist AI-generated image of Barack and Michelle Obama. Just yesterday, it was reported that world leaders go through _her_ to reach Trump. **So forget the alleged affair for a second. Who controls the information reaching the President of the United States? Who controls access to him? Who gets to shape what the most powerful person in the world sees, hears, and believes?** These are reasonable, credible questions about how a young staffer with a fascinatingly weird background is shaping America's government -- and leaving you worse off. Senator Ossoff has every right to ask them. So does every American.
* * *

* * *
And let me be clear: I have zero sympathy for the MAGA movement screaming from the rooftops about how offensive it is to mention a female staffer. Where was the outrage for a decade of Donald Trump's attacks on women? I might have a shred of sympathy for their argument if they hadn't spent ten years defending his sexism and his abuse.
This is a man all over the Epstein files, which he continues to try to bury. A man credibly accused of multiple sexual assaults. A man currently paying out millions to E. Jean Carroll after being found liable for sexual abuse -- the civil equivalent of an adjudicated rapist. A man who invited Bill Clinton's accusers to a debate to rattle Hillary. A man who, just last week, attacked Abdul El-Sayed's wife -- and not one of these fucks said a word. **They've spent a decade cheering while Donald Trump attacks women, humiliates them, and weaponizes their personal lives for political gain. Apparently, their concern for the dignity of women begins exactly where Donald Trump's humiliation does.**
The pushback tells you everything. If this weren't a real problem for Trump, his White House, and his movement, they would have ignored a throwaway line in a Senate speech. Instead, it hit a nerve. It pissed off Trump. It pissed off Melania. The reporting says they thought it was "below the belt" -- which is hilarious, because below the belt is the only place Donald Trump ever punches.
For the first time in a long time, a major Democratic politician has gotten this far under Trump's skin and put the entire White House on tilt. Staffers are falling over themselves to leak on Harp to get her fired -- though I doubt it works, because Trump seems as devoted to her as she is to him. It's symbiotic. **And the harder they fight to make questions about Harp off-limits, the more important those questions become.**
So the media needs to stay on this. Independent creators need to stay on this. You need to stay on this. **And not because we need to know whether Donald Trump is having an affair. We need to know who is exercising power around the President of the United States.** This is a woman who shapes Trump's worldview, controls his narrative, controls his time, controls his mind -- while the man himself is in serious cognitive decline. Yesterday he stood in front of the White House bragging that he's "very good at flagpoles." I don't know what the fuck that means, and no amount of context will make it sound sane.
We're in a scary moment. Asking hard questions about who surrounds a president waging an illegal war, wrecking the global economy, and stealing billions from the American people isn't just fair -- it's your patriotic duty. **Who has his ear? Who controls his access? Who decides what information reaches him? Those aren 't gossip-column questions. They're questions about power. And power necessitates accountability.** Don't let them shame you out of **asking them**. **Donald Trump works for you. Natalie Harp works for you. This government belongs to** _**you**_**.** Questioning your government is the whole point. Especially when the people running it are begging you to look away.
With urgency,
--Mike

body:
It’s Governor Wes Moore. Five years ago, I had never run for political office. I was a former Army Captain, a dad to two young kids, and I ran one of the largest poverty-fighting organizations in the country. But I knew more had to be done. While career politicians were saying that everything was great, **I was hearing from folks all across Maryland who were feeling left behind.** So I ran for Governor with a mission to make Maryland a state that serves all our people — and won. (And I’m not done yet!) **Our mission must continue this year.** I’m running for re-election so we can keep building on the progress we’ve made on jobs, education, public safety, and more. There are tough fights on the horizon, and there’s so much more for us to accomplish together. Yesterday, Hunter Biden sat down with me and David Shuster on Amped Up--and inside the first ten minutes, he broke some news.
You probably saw last week's headlines suggesting Joe Biden might have only months to live. Hunter says that take got "blown way out of proportion," and he walked us through what the diagnosis actually means: stage four prostate cancer, treated successfully with radiation. Metastatic bone cancer, managed with hormone therapy--rough treatment, but one his dad can live with. And then the sentence worth reading twice: "He will live as long as he was going to live regardless of the cancer."
That's the clip above. Watch it. Send it to the friend who's been worried sick since last week.
And that was just the opening. In the full interview, Hunter told us what was really going through his head while Marjorie Taylor Greene displayed his private photos to Congress--and why he'd already won before he walked into that room. He read us the scorecard comparing his paintings (every buyer testified under oath) to the Trump kids' billions in defense contracts. **He said the quiet part about Kamala Harris out loud. He went at Jake Tapper --and I mean went at him. He challenged Don Jr. to the octagon. Again.**
The full interview is for paid subscribers. That's not a tollbooth for the sake of it--it's how a small independent shop books conversations like this one without a corporate suit deciding which questions are polite. You fund it; you get all of it.

| | | | | **2026 August e-newsletter**
####
---
|
* Step Back in Time at Rancho Day Fiesta

* Caltrain at a Critical Crossroads
* Celebrating a New Gateway to San Bruno Mountain
* Building Age-Friendly Communities for Every Generation

---
| | |
---
|
# “As wildfires rage across the state, nation and world and with a heat wave arriving, now is the time to prepare your families and communities how to be prepared to minimize the risk"
# **\- Supervisor David Canepa**
---
| | | | **2026 August e-newsletter** **Building Age-Friendly Communities for Every Generation** Dear friends, Nearly a decade ago, I helped launch an effort based on a simple idea: San Mateo County should be a place where people can age with dignity, independence and connection. That vision has grown into one of the most successful countywide Age-Friendly initiatives in California. With an initial Measure K investment, and approximately $1 million in total County Measure K support over the years, the Center for Age-Friendly Excellence, or CAFE, has helped transform how our cities plan for a rapidly aging population. Since July 2018, CAFE has supported 14 San Mateo County cities in becoming certified and joining AARP’s Network of Age-Friendly States and Communities, while developing eight local action plans to help communities become more livable for people of all ages. CAFE's work goes beyond a designation. It brings residents, local governments, nonprofits and community partners together to examine transportation, housing, accessibility, social connection, health and other issues that affect our quality of life. Its mission is to improve the health, well-being and quality of life of older adults and people with disabilities through community-driven planning, direct services and cross-sector collaboration. Today, the Age-Friendly movement is also an important part of our broader effort to combat isolation and loneliness and build stronger connections between neighbors and generations. The County’s Measure K investments have supported seniors, people with disabilities and other residents through programs designed to improve quality of life. I am proud that an idea we began nearly a decade ago has grown into a countywide movement. As San Mateo County ages, we must continue planning not just for longer lives, but for better lives, where residents can remain active, connected and engaged in the communities they call home. See a video on an Age-Friendly workshop in Brisbane here: **[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5rnJ7Mp6xo8&list=PLceI4wCiqVySkfQ4tEAbhaEAjZ_tu5ktL&index=1](https://us.list-manage.com/kE0HdTLoIzO?e=c0babbc643&c2id=bfcaacdd1ef4033edfed3d4b1d472a02 "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5rnJ7Mp6xo8&list=PLceI4wCiqVySkfQ4tEAbhaEAjZ_tu5ktL&index=1")** ** ** **Celebrating a New Gateway to San Bruno Mountain** I was proud to join our community in celebrating the ribbon cutting of the new Day Use Improvement Project and Interpretive Center at San Bruno Mountain County and State Park. San Bruno Mountain is one of San Mateo County’s great natural treasures, a place where families, students, hikers and visitors can experience the outdoors, take in spectacular views and learn about the unique ecosystems that make this mountain so special. I was pleased to secure $2 million in Measure K funding to help get this important project off the ground. Those dollars have been transformed into a more welcoming, accessible and educational space for everyone who visits. The improvements include a new interpretive pavilion and gathering space, educational displays, nearly two dozen new picnic tables and BBQ grills, and a larger restroom facility with four all-gender, ADA-accessible restrooms, sinks and changing tables. Six of the park’s nine new picnic sites are fully accessible, and a circular paved pathway connects the sites, making it easier for people of all abilities to enjoy the park. The project was also shaped by community input gathered through surveys in 2022 and 2023, ensuring these improvements reflect the needs and priorities of the people who use and love San Bruno Mountain. This is about more than new buildings and picnic tables. It is about creating a place where people can gather, learn about our local environment and build connections with one another and the outdoors. I am incredibly proud of this investment and grateful to San Mateo County Parks, the community and everyone who helped bring this vision to life. I encourage everyone to visit San Bruno Mountain and experience this beautiful new space for themselves. The above photo is courtesy of San Mateo County Parks Ranger Rob Cala. See an NBC report on the ribbon cutting here: [https://www.nbcbayarea.com/news/local/upgrades-san-bruno-mountain-state-county-park/4084171/](https://us.list-manage.com/C3zuP2PJfA0?e=c0babbc643&c2id=bfcaacdd1ef4033edfed3d4b1d472a02 "https://www.nbcbayarea.com/news/local/upgrades-san-bruno-mountain-state-county-park/4084171/") **Caltrain at a Critical Crossroads** Caltrain is one of the Peninsula’s greatest transportation assets, but it is approaching a serious fiscal cliff that could have major consequences for San Mateo County residents. The concern is especially striking because Caltrain is succeeding. Ridership is growing, customer satisfaction is strong, and the new electrified system is providing faster, cleaner and more reliable service. Yet without a stable, long-term source of funding, Caltrain could face an annual operating deficit of approximately $75 million and potentially significant service reductions in the coming years. The consequences could be dramatic: The elimination of weekend service, trains running only once an hour, station closures, earlier service endings and fewer transportation options for families, workers, students and seniors. That would mean more cars on Highway 101, more traffic and more pollution. It would also undermine the tremendous public investment already made to modernize and electrify this critical rail system. As a Caltrain Board member, I believe maintaining a strong transit system is an investment in our environment, economy and quality of life. Every person who chooses the train instead of driving helps reduce congestion and greenhouse gas emissions. Caltrain also connects people to jobs, schools, businesses and communities throughout the Peninsula. In November, voters will have a choice regarding whether to provide dedicated funding for Caltrain's future. That decision comes at an important moment for the railroad and the communities it serves. The question is not whether Caltrain matters, it clearly does. The challenge before us is how we ensure that this vital public asset has the financial stability necessary to continue serving future generations.

**Step Back in Time at Rancho Day Fiesta** Families can step back into California’s rancho era at the annual Rancho Day Fiesta, a free, family-friendly event hosted by the San Mateo County Historical Association at the historic Sánchez Adobe in Pacifica. Visitors will travel back to the 1840s, when Don Francisco Sanchez raised cattle at Rancho San Pedro, and experience history through hands-on activities. Kids and adults can make adobe bricks, stamp leather, dip candles, create corn husk dolls and churn butter. Guests can also learn how early Californios danced and discover what daily life was like during the rancho period. The event is a wonderful opportunity for families to experience local history in a fun, interactive way and admission is free. The Sánchez Adobe is a unique piece of San Mateo County’s history and a great place to introduce young people to our region’s past. **Date:** Saturday, September 19
**Time:** Noon–4 p.m.
**Address:** Sánchez Adobe, 1000 Linda Mar Blvd., Pacifica
**More information:** [San Mateo County Historical Association](https://us.list-manage.com/xvmuek4fVE6?e=c0babbc643&c2id=bfcaacdd1ef4033edfed3d4b1d472a02 "https://www.historysmc.org?utm_source=chatgpt.com")
In friendship,
**DAVID J. CANEPA**
San Mateo County Board of Supervisors

name: Voto Latino
subject: Latino voters are at a breaking point
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
1 in 5 Latino Trump voters now say they regret voting for Trump.
#
Peter,
**Latino voters are at a breaking point.**
After two years of out-of-control costs and unlawful and inhumane attacks on our community from ICE, 1 in 5 Latino Trump voters now say they regret their choice, and they’re ready for change.
We're seeing the proof in Texas’s 15th Congressional District, where Latino voters flipped this seat red and helped elect Trump in 2024.

Something unusual happened in the gold market this year.

After surging to record highs near **$5,600 an ounce** , gold pulled back sharply, trading in the **$4,000s** in recent months, according to reporting from Business Insider and Finance Magnates.

Cable news called it a correction. Skeptics called it the top.

But investors who have studied gold's history saw something very different:
**A door that wasn't supposed to open again.**
Every major gold bull market in modern history has included sharp pullbacks along the way. And in nearly every case, those pullbacks looked like the end. They weren't. They were the moments when patient buyers stepped in while everyone else hesitated.

Consider the closest historical parallel to today.

In **1979 and 1980** , America faced a combination of forces that should sound familiar: runaway government spending, stubborn inflation, geopolitical chaos overseas, and a growing loss of confidence in Washington's ability to manage any of it.

During that period, gold surged approximately **271%.**

The investors who benefited most were not the ones who bought at the peak of the panic. They were the ones who bought during the pauses, when headlines said the move was over.

Now look at what's driving gold today:

**✔** **U.S. federal debt has crossed $38 trillion** , with annual interest payments now exceeding $1 trillion a year, more than the entire defense budget

**✔** **Central banks purchased 244 tonnes of gold in the first quarter of 2026 alone** , the strongest opening quarter on record, according to Kitco

**✔** **Gold has now overtaken U.S. Treasuries** as a share of global central bank reserves

**✔** **Trade wars and Middle East instability** continue to push institutional money toward hard assets

**✔** **The IMF has downgraded growth forecasts** as recession risk climbs

In other words: the same forces that drove gold in 1979 are visible again. Economic uncertainty. Geopolitical chaos. Loss of confidence in the currency.

The difference is that this time, you can watch it happen. Bullish analysts at outlets like CBS News began calling the dip a potential entry point rather than an exit. And the market may already be proving them right: gold has climbed roughly **9% in the past month** and reopened above **$4,300 for the first time since mid-June** , per Trading Economics and Yahoo Finance, while Deutsche Bank has lifted its forecast and says gold is setting up for a run toward **$5,000**.

No one can promise where gold goes next. Anyone who does is not being honest with you.

But history suggests windows like this one do not stay open long. This one is already measurably narrowing.

subject: The antidote to Drag Queen Story Hour
body:
---

---

---
_**A Special Message from our Sponsor**_ _Please note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of_ _Free Speech Daily_ _and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by Free Speech Daily_ _._
---
| BRAVE For Good We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. | | | | | Friend, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, **[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzR9AAwAAAAAAncV0xLYHAvjnDRhZvQviJTtfUvpEcwNGI7u8nqYnmzZWoPp30RqUOnAIf9vCuaXcUt_pKstO_KJzEnNc2mig7WkjCHugmU5YGkWmLWFzA)** Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian. She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_. **But today, all that has changed.** Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series. And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby._ “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.” I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...but that’s just not true.
---
[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzR9AAwAAAAAAncV0xLZNU2RbnjYn9tK5-E83IF8UaCscp2wfnNtfUeuBNZK4DxFCTjYwr_2DiWjG8tqoge5ius9CgDhIn3Sx9KO634sMPPJBfLv0h1j0w)
---
THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour”
---
**[That’s why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through See You At The Library Day.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzR9AAwAAAAAAncV0xLaWWeneFMGF09NSlQwFfk2fJdUtKJOJAqDenBCcxaMiHcvzTlxOWPpmFQCAbvLdQqthADTFuDAZl6q9FW2nzNLdV1PLhqWiPmIHg)** For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.**And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.** Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone. The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse. **But here’s what’s really alarming.** We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.” That may be good for your family -- for now. **But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of _other_ children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!** _**[I hope you see why I need your help today.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzR9AAwAAAAAAncV0xLbQc3dYWGcnth1ebOiSJ8VaCVWCt9Ov_SlGfx7Xk_CsgBzulBU_lwPSbUfaffcZpps-Hl1yIBYkXOdzATWW3_DFCS23ccNz_qTMQ) **_ My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.” I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood. But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian. When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit. **Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with _conservative Story Hours_ filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.**And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit.
---
* Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.

---
* The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves.

---
* Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.

---
I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States. **And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.** It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part... From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own. And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born. Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours” filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God. Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. **[And this year, honoring America’s 250th birthday, my ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to reach 250,000 children.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzR9AAwAAAAAAncV0xLcQ_uQoEGdkXoO2jO-0HUAU93hj6ybLvWWZBuL9EmMFpxHuGBe5Yui_q6NA-AEx5sQRnu3qrrIA_LMR4ORfGC9xHez07ZdIRNS4g)** The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming. That’s a very good thing. But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. **[That’s why I’ve teamed with a very special non-profit called BRAVE for Good to make this year’s “See You at the Library Day” a bigger success than ever.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzR9AAwAAAAAAncV0xLd90YNRrWdD4tRtk3wqWOB7o-C-Szv3HWMg7IrweGb5gztBuq61SFRKBaKrcIkgWy_qyK2jLGwRE0zBb03_aSu9ZzundF6jFHmDQ)** **BRAVE for Good** was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift. **Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event.** The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. **Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries.** We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. **[Knowing that, please consider a sponsorship gift of $125. That’s enough to sponsor one entire ‘Story Hour Kit’ yourself.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzR9AAwAAAAAAncV0xLe4WWI-qmWrlIezl9i4Eef4RrcGGaaJ29-yrOrIjLE_FB81gudmOA1PKUNzXA9hpA5cSbSG652d9LN4Jif5kHbFL8ImznyHeUBaw)** Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. **[Whatever you can give whether it’s $35, $125, or anything higher or lower please send in your sponsorship gift in the next 48 hours so we know how many libraries we have sponsored for this year’s “See You at the Library Day.”](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzR9AAwAAAAAAncV0xLfVlkZCUh4sjbYMtYwDW70seKJ6W5-g1Uq7pvjP0ZNuYCmsnkZ2ZdwQnbCOWX3tQ-WCizGnZxFTzw_AGD-abMiIwTfF75jVHiPfw)**
---
| | | Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America,**Kirk Cameron**

She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the Three Musketeers , Treasure Island and Charlotte’s Web. But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call Adventures of Huckleberry Finn and To Kill a Mockingbird “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ Little House series. And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” Prince and Knight. The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.” I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...but that’s just not true. THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour” For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone. The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: Rick about a cross-dressing Grandpa, Melissa filled with graphic nudity, and Darkstalker featuring gory violence and domestic abuse. But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.” That may be good for your family -- for now. But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.” I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood. But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian. When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit. Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour. The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on. I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States. And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books. It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part... From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own. And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born. Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours” filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God. Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming. That’s a very good thing. But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. BRAVE for Good was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift. Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. | | | Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America,Kirk Cameron | | | | | 100 I-45 N 260 Conroe, TX 77301

Peter,
**$555.**
That's what it costs to renew DACA. For a lot of working families, that's a significant piece of a monthly budget that already has to cover groceries, rent, gas, and school supplies. And it comes due whether or not the money is there.
When a renewal lapses, the consequences land fast. Work gets harder to find, and people are exposed to detention, deportation, and separation from their families. One of the most direct ways we can keep our community safe is to remove financial barriers to renewing.
Citizenship is the only lasting solution to the chaos and instability the mass delegalization efforts are creating. But Congress has not acted, and a renewal deadline does not wait for lawmakers. **Right now, this fund is the most concrete tool we have to protect our community, and the waitlist grows longer by the day.**
**[Every application we help fund is one more person who keeps their job, stays with their family, and holds their ground. With your help, we can close the gap. # [Bitcoin explodes through $72K after Trump's Clarity Act surge](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Bitcoin **[climbed more than 9.3%](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd0a9c6-2a11-4dd3-ad15-9655fa889038?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Thursday to **[above $72,000,](https://substack.com/redirect/e9b99f7e-d8dc-415d-b31e-c1a403e29623?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** its highest level since June 1, after **[President Trump met crypto executives,](https://substack.com/redirect/e4ec46e4-a055-4bdc-b71e-0775cb1b5f37?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** urged a fair version of the Clarity Act, and yields fell sharply.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Yields drop triggers rally:** Treasury yields pulled back sharply after U.S. plans to buy longer-dated bonds, sending the dollar to a three-month low and lifting risk assets including bitcoin more than 3% Thursday.
* **Short squeeze amplifies gains:** Roughly $2.7 billion in crypto short positions were liquidated in 24 hours, building on bitcoin's 7% prior-day surge for a two-day gain exceeding 11% from the $63,000 level.
* **Trump hosts industry leaders:** The White House meeting included CEOs from Coinbase, Kraken, Robinhood, Ripple and ChainLink as Trump called for the Clarity Act to keep the U.S. ahead of China.
* **Possible government purchases:** Trump signaled the U.S. is reviewing plans to buy bitcoin and digital assets at a sizeable scale, a shift from the March 2025 Strategic Bitcoin Reserve funded mainly by seized assets.

# [AI spending just turbocharged S&P 500 Q2 earnings](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
S&P 500 companies are **[set for a 52% surge in second-quarter earnings year-over-year,](https://substack.com/redirect/bdce59e5-f269-4206-9ed6-b3c8b0a996c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** driven by a 74% profit jump in technology and large mark-to-market gains at Alphabet and Amazon from stakes in AI firms like Anthropic.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Excluding Mark Gains:** Without the investment mark-to-market boosts, estimated profit growth would be 33%, still the strongest quarter since 2021 according to LSEG data.
* **AI Infrastructure Role:** Goldman Sachs strategists say AI infrastructure stocks account for roughly one-third of S&P 500 earnings per share growth this quarter.
* **Nvidia Guarantee Plan:** Nvidia plans a guarantee of up to $105 billion to help OpenAI lease a large data center in Ohio amid AI buildout costs.
* **Investor Caution Grows:** Analysts warn mark-to-market gains can reverse quickly and circular financing plus high valuations raise risks of future disappointments.

# [Alibaba profits crash 75% after heavy AI spending binge](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
China's Alibaba **[reported a 75% plunge in June-quarter profits](https://substack.com/redirect/fcbb477d-4039-49aa-92f4-485000a3d294?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as AI-driven capital spending jumped 75% to 67.7 billion yuan, or $10 billion, while total revenue rose 9% and cloud revenue surged 45%.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Cloud Division Climbs:** Key cloud unit revenue reached 48.4 billion yuan, up 45% year-on-year as AI demand accelerates for the tech giant.
* **AI Products Surge:** AI-related product revenue posted triple-digit growth for the twelfth consecutive quarter, according to CEO Eddie Wu.
* **Spending Weighs Profits:** Capital expenditure rose primarily from increased CPU-compute capacity and higher chip component prices across the board.
* **Shares Fall Sharply:** U.S.-listed shares dropped 3.1% after initial 4% premarket losses following the earnings release on Thursday.

# [Micron's $50 billion bet is rewriting Boise's future forever](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Micron's **[$50 billion chip fab buildout in Boise is creating over 17,000 jobs](https://substack.com/redirect/58cb00e2-cf35-4eea-b22a-3bde7ff0da69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and turning employees into millionaires after the stock's more than tenfold rise since late 2024 pushed market cap past $1 trillion amid AI memory demand.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Jobs And Facilities:** Two new manufacturing plants expected to add more than 17,000 jobs including 3,500 at Micron, which already employs about 7,000 locally.
* **Stock Wealth Boom:** Wealth managers help clients diversify after stock surge, with some seeing portfolios grow from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands or millions.
* **Local Impacts Felt:** Boise sees traffic, rising rents up 4.3%, and influx of residents while some benefit from Micron-linked prosperity and others do not.
* **U.S. Production Push:** First new Boise fab online in 2027 as first U.S. front-end for leading-edge memory; long-term goal 40% DRAM production in America.

# [Super Micro: Our leaders say they knew nothing about this](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Super Micro Computer completed an independent investigation[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/aca8cd47-bbac-4aed-a979-140a5dfeffa5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[concluding senior management had no knowledge](https://substack.com/redirect/aca8cd47-bbac-4aed-a979-140a5dfeffa5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** of an alleged scheme diverting Nvidia-powered servers to China, with no evidence of direct sales to restricted parties or unreliable financial statements.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Personnel Actions Taken:** The company took several steps including terminations following the probe into its export compliance program related to the allegations.
* **Board Enhances Program:** Independent directors recommended further improvements to export compliance, which the board adopted in full after the review.
* **Legal Background:** U.S. prosecutors charged a Super Micro co-founder and two others with illegally diverting billions in Nvidia servers via Southeast Asia to Chinese customers; all pleaded not guilty.
* **Shares Respond Positively:** Super Micro stock rose as much as 5.9% after the company announced the investigation findings on Thursday.

# [Hyundai just dropped a massive luxury EV to challenge Tesla](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Hyundai Motor's Genesis brand **[launched its new flagship all-electric large SUV,](https://substack.com/redirect/0e8aa953-6489-4cc6-a4f9-2d846c85b0b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** the GV90, seating up to seven with up to 660 horsepower and 310-mile range, set for U.S. sale early next year from a South Korean plant.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Largest Genesis Yet:** The GV90 is the biggest vehicle offered by the luxury brand since its U.S. market entry a decade ago, expanding the lineup to seven models.
* **Coach Door Option:** Available as GV90 Neolun with rare coach doors opening from the middle, plus standard trims and a plush First Edition variant.
* **Power And Range:** Features high-performance electric motors delivering up to 490 kilowatts or about 660 horsepower and roughly 310 miles of expected range.
* **Sales Growth Continues:** Genesis U.S. sales rose about 5% to 39,088 units in the first half, marking 22 consecutive months of year-over-year gains.

# [Bugatti's problem? Too many collectors, not enough cars](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Bugatti CEO Mate Rimac **[says over-demand far exceeds supply after the company's most successful year in 116 years](https://substack.com/redirect/14eac4b8-8cf9-4bf2-a60f-f72837f42487?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with record production, prompting plans to double annual capacity to 200 cars for its ultra-wealthy collector base.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Demand Far Exceeds:** With about 300,000 ultra-high-net-worth individuals worldwide and only 100 cars produced yearly, Bugatti serves less than 1% of that population.
* **Capacity Expansion:** The brand will double production to 200 vehicles a year just to keep up with growing collector interest in multi-million-dollar models.
* **One-Off Program:** Programme Solitaire builds two bespoke one-of-one cars annually; the new Destrier is the third, estimated at $15 million to $20 million.
* **Collector Appeal:** Buying a Bugatti is the ultimate "I made it" statement, and top collectors help design the unique cars with engineers and name them.

# [Lincoln production surges in the U.S. as China imports die](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Ford **[plans to expand U.S. production of Lincoln vehicles](https://substack.com/redirect/e7a8b7c8-ae4c-4341-95e7-5d0422c80e58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** beginning in 2030 and eventually stop importing vehicles from China for American customers, a move expected to generate thousands of direct and indirect jobs.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Current China Link:** The redesigned Nautilus is assembled at the Changan Ford plant in Hangzhou, China, and exported to the U.S. market.
* **U.S. Footprint Strong:** Lincoln already builds the Navigator in Louisville, Kentucky, and Aviator in Chicago; Ford assembled more than 2 million vehicles in the U.S. in 2025.
* **Tariff Context:** Ford reported about $3 billion in gross costs from 2025 tariffs, with roughly $2 billion impact on EBIT after offsets, though it did not link the decision to tariffs.
* **Employment Scale:** The company employs approximately 56,300 hourly manufacturing workers in the U.S. and leads in U.S. vehicle exports and hourly autoworker jobs.

# [Meta's child safety trial carries a $1.4 trillion bombshell risk](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A federal trial in Oakland by four states leading a 29-state coalition accuses Meta of **[misleading the public on risks to young users](https://substack.com/redirect/1d202b45-0652-43ad-b9f1-3a64f5949d0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and designing Facebook and Instagram features that keep children hooked, **[with potential penalties up to $1.4 trillion near its market cap.](https://substack.com/redirect/63915a90-02d5-4ce5-98da-a5b6a0f73211?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/82ec3052-c3a0-4f6c-a942-68768736de67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **High Stakes Penalties:** Meta says the theoretical maximum under the states' theory approaches the value of the company itself and could effectively transfer stockholder value to the public.
* **Advisory Jury Role:** An eight-person jury is advisory only while U.S. District Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers will decide liability and any remedies in the case.
* **Company Financial Scale:** Meta generated nearly $201 billion in revenue last year and held more than $90 billion in cash and marketable securities at the end of June.
* **Stock And Prior Cases:** Shares fell as the trial started and remain down 17% this year; prior juries found Meta misled teens or liable with Google over addiction claims.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137599003/641329737/-64453068?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&first_name=&refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260820_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDAzZGMzMDMtYmY5Yy1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAwZDNhMTFmYTMwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=v4BWpJBnZ5uxHrnrubGY4gU1ZRjBTpcFU55IdJd8V-0=) **Then I headed south to Georgia to campaign with Keisha Lance Bottoms.** Keisha knows families are getting squeezed, and she has a plan to expand Medicaid, lower health care costs, and make life a little easier for Georgians. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137599004/641329738/-64453068?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&first_name=&refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260820_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDAzZGMzMDMtYmY5Yy1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAwZDNhMTFmYTMwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=v4BWpJBnZ5uxHrnrubGY4gU1ZRjBTpcFU55IdJd8V-0=) **Next stop: Ohio, where I joined Dr. Amy Acton.** Amy has spent her career looking out for people, even when doing the right thing wasn’t easy. Peter,

Our general election is underway, and _a lot_ has been happening. Outside money is flooding in. The attacks keep coming. And you've been with me every step of the way.

So I want to take a step back from all that — and remind you why I got in this race to begin with. **[If you already know you're with us, you can chip in $3 right now and I'll see you on the other side. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137599100/641330018/1981932151?refcode=em-8.20.26-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODFlOTU4NzktYmY5Yy1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAwZDNhMTFmYTMwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ul2GEn9IdQhB_9zDG70eVLqAMNWq5bX8a-2fNqXFDH8=)
_Back in the day at Palla Elementary School in Bakersfield (Go Bulldogs!)_
I grew up in Bakersfield, the son of Mexican immigrants. My dad opened an auto shop here in 2006. My mom was a homemaker. We didn't have much — I shared a bunk bed in the living room with my brothers. On weekends, I worked at the swap meet and helped out at the shop.

Nobody in my family had ever gone to college. I was the first.

I watched my parents work themselves to the bone in a Valley that wasn’t built for families like ours. I watched my older brother navigate life as a DACA recipient, always one policy change away from losing everything. I proudly saw my younger brother put on a uniform to serve our country as a Marine.

The Central Valley made me who I am. And for a long time, I thought the best way I could give back was to teach. So I became a professor at College of the Sequoias and a school board trustee -- making sure kids in this Valley had more doors open to them than I did.

But something kept nagging at me.

CA-22 has been represented by David Valadao for years. He looked Central Valley families in the eye and promised us he would never cut Medicaid — which is a lifeline for hundreds of thousands of our neighbors. Then he voted for Trump's budget and did exactly that.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137599101/641330019/1981932151?refcode=em-8.20.26-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODFlOTU4NzktYmY5Yy1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAwZDNhMTFmYTMwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ul2GEn9IdQhB_9zDG70eVLqAMNWq5bX8a-2fNqXFDH8=)
I was at those rallies with the nurses, farmworkers, and ordinary working families who couldn't believe their representative had sold them out. And I kept thinking: someone has to run against him. Someone who actually knows what it means to need Medicaid. Someone who grew up and built a life here.

So I got in. Not because I wanted to be something, but because I wanted to _do something_ \-- for the families who can't afford to see a doctor, for the parents who can't afford rent, for the kids growing up in a Valley with dirty air, broken promises and no one in Washington fighting for them.

And with your support, we’re going to win.

**[Corporate PACs and special interests are propping up Valadao's campaign, and they're not going anywhere between now and November. We need to keep our message in front of voters. | | | | | | Peter,
You don’t need a politician to tell you that life in Pennsylvania is getting more expensive. You feel it every month.
❌ Your electric bill is higher than it was a year ago — and another increase is coming
❌ Your natural gas bill is going up this fall
❌ Your property taxes keep climbing
❌ Insurance premiums — homeowners, auto, health — are all up
❌ Groceries and everyday essentials cost more than they did two years ago
And what is Josh Shapiro doing about any of it?
Nothing. He’s the highest-paid governor in America, presiding over the 47th-ranked economy in the country, and he doesn’t have a single plan to lower your costs.
**We do.**
Here’s what a Garrity Administration will do to make life affordable again:
⚡ Cut your utility bills by 15–25% by eliminating hidden costs on electric bills, rolling back the gross receipts tax, and much more.
🏠 Launch the HOPE for PA initiative to cut property taxes by one-third within two years — so seniors stop losing homes they’ve lived in for decades
💰 Reduce the overall tax burden — Pennsylvania has the 5th highest in the nation, and it’s driving families and businesses out of the state
🏭 Make data centers pay their own way — so big tech stops driving up your energy costs
🔑 Create a first-time homebuyer program covering up to 3% of mortgage interest rates
Pennsylvanians are working harder, paying more, and getting less. That’s not an accident — it’s the result of a Governor who cares more about his political future than your financial present.
It’s time to turn Pennsylvania around.
– Team Garrity

But Republican outside groups have already spent or reserved nearly $7 million in advertising here, and this race is a pure toss-up.** Waiting while they fill the airwaves attacking me isn’t much of a strategy. **[So I’m asking: Will you chip in $5, $10, or whatever you can today to help us cover this ad buy and keep our message on the air?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137601040/641335499/724950626?refcode=260820-greenlight&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzczMGNlYS1jMjljLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SbdCua99sb7vRnvDLdvwgyPN9xig84RI5gCyaHEwwAQ=)**

If we wait until every dollar is sitting in the bank, the best opportunities to reach voters could already be gone. Meanwhile, national Republicans know exactly how important this seat is. Donald Trump carried our district twice. Speaker Mike Johnson came here personally to raise money for my opponent. And Republican groups with hundreds of millions of dollars to spend have made it clear that Southwest Washington is one of their top targets. **They can afford to wait us out. We can’t afford to let them.** I don’t take corporate PAC money. We don't have billionaires waiting in the wings to write whatever check we need. What we have is a campaign that has won this district twice because thousands of people decided it was worth putting some skin in the game. name: Gabby Giffords
subject: My humble request
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

| | | | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
| Good morning! This is Gabby, and I’m reaching out to humbly ask you to make a contribution of $3 to GIFFORDS PAC.

With the election in just 75 days, everything is on the line. The gun lobby is starting to spend money in top races to prop up their extreme candidates, right as polling is tied.

Many of our races could be decided by just a handful of votes. If we don’t start fighting back, the gun lobby’s money could be enough to tip the scales and stall our progress for another two years.

So I am asking:

[**If you are frustrated by the direction of our country, and you are ready to do something about it, then please donate to GIFFORDS PAC.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/66845?c0=giff-em-q32026.bXvd9H&refcode=em260820-1-b&t=1&akid=11747%2E3935704%2E0OTg3U)

GIFFORDS is working to build the largest grassroots mobilization program in the country, and our work is only successful thanks to grassroots donors like you. Thank you.
Gabby Giffords
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/66845?c0=giff-em-q32026.bXvd9H&refcode=em260820-1-b&t=2&akid=11747%2E3935704%2E0OTg3U)**

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=3&akid=11747%2E3935704%2E0OTg3U) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

Friend, We have less than two weeks until Massachusetts’ September 1 Election Day, and **I’m proud to endorse progressive champion Ed Markey in his re-election for the U.S. Senate.** Ed Markey was **one of the first Senators to call for abolishing ICE** , and among only a few progressive Senators who joined me in endorsing Dr. Abdul El-Sayed in his primary election to represent Michigan in the U.S. Senate. We’re all **aligned on Medicare for All** — and Ed has written powerful legislation such as the _State-Based Universal Health Care Act_ , so states can build universal coverage now instead of waiting on the federal government. **I’ve also worked with Ed on policies like the**** _Fossil Free Finance Act_** to end major funding for the fossil fuel projects that pollute our air and accelerate climate chaos. As a co-chair of the Senate’s Environmental Justice Caucus, Ed supported me in forming the Environmental Justice Caucus in the House of Representatives. Ed knows that **instead of sending weapons to Israel’s military or funding illegal wars, our tax dollars should go toward universal healthcare** , the Green New Deal, affordable housing, free public transit, and expanding programs like Social Security and Medicaid. But **he’s up against a Democrat who’s against Medicare for All — and who has voted with Republicans** on policies that thank ICE and send our tax dollars to weapons corporations and war crimes. **[With less than two weeks left in his primary election, please split a donation between my and Ed Markey’s re-election campaigns today. Senator Ed Markey is also **the Senate’s** **top supporter of transgender Americans.** Sen. Markey has written and introduced groundbreaking legislation like the _Trans Bill of Rights_ and the _Transgender Health Care Access Act._
**Meanwhile, his opponent has repeatedly made transphobic comments** and said that Democrats need to engage in “debate” about trans Americans’ rights — repeating right-wing talking points that contribute to the demonization of some of our most marginalized neighbors.
Ed’s opponent Seth Moulton has also criticized attempts to hold Israel’s government accountable for its genocide in Gaza, including speaking out against South Africa’s case in the International Court of Justice. AIPAC has donated to Moulton in the past, and Moulton is still refusing to join me and the other 73 U.S. Representatives who support the _Block the Bombs Act_.
Meanwhile, **Ed has consistently voted for years to block weapons to Israel’s military** , and to expand human rights at home and abroad.
**Ed’s also a leader in the fight to tax the ultra-rich in order to pay for the life-saving programs that working Americans need.** Whereas his opponent has criticized wealth taxes in the past — even calling progressive Senators “un-American” for wanting to “punish the rich.”
The residents of the deep blue state of Massachusetts need progressive champion Ed Markey to keep representing them in the Senate.
And our country needs a progressive majority in Congress in order to pass transformative changes to end poverty, end genocide, and get Big Money out of politics. But**dark money is flooding Ed Markey’s race to stop his re-election.**

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Carleigh Beriont for Congress
body:
An issue a day

| |
---
| | _With just nineteen days until the primary, I am using each day to discuss an issue I have highlighted on the campaign trail. For Day 19, I am highlighting the need to hold Big Tech accountable, get dark money out of politics, and restore our democracy._
* * *
Dear David, Our democracy is battered and bruised, and it didn’t happen overnight. As much damage as Donald Trump has done, he hasn’t done it alone. The President and his cronies have exploited weaknesses in our democracy that were caused by massive corporate spending and the rise of unprecedented monopoly power, particularly in the tech industry. Too many people in Washington have either looked the other way or profited from it themselves. Members of Congress trade stock on information the rest of us don’t have access to. Dark money is flooding our elections. A handful of tech companies are overpowering small businesses and monopolizing entire industries. Elon Musk is about to spend an enormous amount of money trying to buy this election for Republicans.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email?amount=25]
His super PAC, America PAC, spent more than $260 million to help elect Donald Trump in 2024 — making Musk the largest individual political donor in a single election cycle in American history. Now he's resuscitating that machine for the midterms, with an army of door-knockers, direct mail, and digital ads aimed squarely at bailing Republicans out of an ugly political environment.
Republican super PACs already have a $300 million-plus cash advantage over Democrats. That's before Musk's money even lands. Add in the $400 million sitting in Trump's own MAGA Inc. super PAC, and you start to understand exactly what we're up against.
Will you chip in $25 or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now right now to help us fight back? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email?amount=25]
Here's the thing Elon Musk doesn't understand, and never will.
We may not have a trillionaire's pocketbook at our disposal, but we don't need it. We just need grassroots donors like you to step up and chip in.
Because here's what Musk's money can't buy: The trust of working families who are watching their costs rise while billionaires get richer. It can't buy authenticity. It can't buy candidates who actually understand what it's like to struggle, to sacrifice, to build something out of nothing.
That's exactly what Equal Opportunity Now is built to counterbalance.
Musk wants to flood swing districts with cash to bail out a party defending an unpopular president, an unpopular war, and an economy that isn't working for regular people. We're going to counter that with real people, chipping in what they can, backing real fighters in the districts that matter most.
He's betting his money can drown out the truth. We're betting that grassroots people-power beats a trillionaire's ego every single time.
Will you chip in $25 or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now today to help us prove him wrong? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email?amount=25]
DONATE NOW TO STAND UP TO ELON MUSK » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email?amount=25]
He's got the money. We've got the people. Let's show him which one wins.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi

clean_body: | Fellow American, it's Michele Tafoya, and you need to hear about what happened. I was on the ground for a professional women's basketball game recently, and it's astonishing to me how this has become ground zero for the Left's latest culture wars. I heard firsthand, Leftist activists shouting obscene remarks at women, simply for saying that men don't belong in girls' sports. | As a mother who 's passionate about youth sports, I felt the urge to intervene.I didn't go for the publicity... I went to stand up for something I'm passionate about and am prepared to staunchly defend.When I first launched this campaign for U.S. Senate in Minnesota, I knew I would have to prepare myself and my family for the pain and vitriol that would be slung my way.But, never in my wildest dreams would I imagine something so basic to be the cause of such heated debate. Biology isn 't complicated. Women are born with a specific set of chromosomes. So are men. They're different. That's why we have women's divisions in sports, so women can compete on a fair playing field. And every roster is finite. Every team excludes someone. That's not bigotry, that's how sports work. Women's sports should belong to women.Fellow American, if you can agree with me on that, then I have a feeling we'll be aligned on plenty of other things.Unfortunately, my far-Left candidate is not the same. She supports biological men in girls' sports, taxpayer-funded surgeries, and largely prefers lunacy over common sense. | Thanks for all that you do. Your support does not go unnoticed.Be brave. Do good.- Michele The Minnesota Senate polls are TIED when voters learn the TRUTH about Minnesota's fraud scandal! I'm not surprised. There isn't a single American who is pro-fraud. But my opponent was too busy defending it or dodging it to notice. I find both disgraceful. Specifically, I'm asking you to sign the "" petition and tell your Governor that the children in your community deserve to hear that: They are wonderfully made in the very image of God. And that God is calling them to love Him above all else. What a country we'd be, if all of America's children had just a little bit of God's Word in their lives - like you did. But in 1963, in a wrongly decided Supreme Court case, the Left ripped the everyday reading of the Bible out of public schools. And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce, abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the family. It is only fitting that during the 250th Anniversary of our independence, we put Biblical lessons BACK into our public schools. Your signature on your "" petition tells our representatives that you want biblical lessons put back in schools. Your signed " " petition is going straight to my friends at BRAVE FOR GOOD. BRAVE FOR GOOD is the powerhouse group behind my "See You at the Library" movement featured on Fox News, that gets conservative Story Hours into public libraries to counter the Left's "Drag Queen Story Hours." BRAVE FOR GOOD is the powerhouse group that got an historic conservative Story Hour into the Library of Congress last year! And BRAVE FOR GOOD is the powerhouse group that will get the Biblical values you cherish - and that America was founded upon - back into public schools this year! HOW? We've designed a mini-curriculum for America's 250th Anniversary that teaches children about the role of the Bible in our nation's Founding and emphasizes the Founding values that have made our country great. Last year I got into three public schools to reach 1,400 children with biblical lessons. That's why BRAVE FOR GOOD is getting ready for the battle by collecting stacks of petitions. Your signed " " petition tells our representatives that the Supreme Court ruling that took the Bible out of schools only specified that the Bible could not be mandatory reading. The 1963 ruling 100% allows for the Bible to be taught in a historical or cultural context! And why wouldn’t it be? In every corner of the world, the Bible is considered one of the greatest books ever written. Of course children should learn about it in your taxpayer-funded schools! But radical educators will try to keep anything to do with the Bible out of our schools and when they do, BRAVE FOR GOOD will be ready to counter them with thousands of signed petitions. Every petition you send digitally must still be delivered, verified, securely collected, and tabulated before it can be presented - and That means your gift today puts hundreds of new voices on the record before the deadline. Together with BRAVE FOR GOOD and patriots like you, we got conservative and patriotic values back into public libraries. Now we're going to get biblical values back into public schools. Peter,
People have asked me what I’ve been up to lately. When I’m not supporting candidates who fight for working families, I’ve been reading!
Here are three books I’ve recently read and recommend this summer:
1. **[_Woodworking_ by Emily St. James](https://act.katieporter.com/go/22160?t=2&akid=41547%2E3422442%2EYfl9n1)**: a tender, thoughtful story about the friendships we build across generations.
2. **[_Fake Skating_ by Lynn Painter](https://act.katieporter.com/go/22161?t=3&akid=41547%2E3422442%2EYfl9n1)**: an age-appropriate teen romance wrapped around a heartfelt story about family.
3. **[_Mad Mabel_ by Sally Hepworth](https://act.katieporter.com/go/22162?t=4&akid=41547%2E3422442%2EYfl9n1)**: a mystery where nobody, even the most I-always-figure-it-out folks, saw the ending coming.

If you want to see more of my book recommendations and author content, you can follow along on Instagram at **[@KatiePorterTurnsThePage.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/22144?t=5&akid=41547%2E3422442%2EYfl9n1)**

Katie Porter

# News From the Road
---
|
---
It was another busy week on the road, with stops at the Brown County Fair and Turner County Fair and plenty of conversations along the way.
At the Brown County Fair, I heard about the impact tariffs are having on a small business, rising housing costs, and the importance of Pre-K to giving our kids a strong start. I also had the chance to sit down for a couple of interviews and attend the Farmers Union panel on property taxes. A big thank you to the Brown County Democrats for sharing campaign materials and helping get signs out into the community.
Tuesday brought beautiful South Dakota weather and a great evening at the Turner County Fair. One concern I heard from folks was the potential for continued cuts to the Department of Education. People are worried about what those cuts could mean for their kids, and it’s a concern I share. Our kids deserve the best, and I’ll work in Washington to make sure every child has access to a quality education, from Pre-K and beyond.
---
|
---
|
---
# On the Blog: We Need a Long-Term Commitment to Rural Health Care
---
While a five-year investment in rural health care could be a great start, we need a long-term commitment to sustaining access to care in rural places. As state leaders conducted listening sessions with community leaders across South Dakota, they heard from lots of people with innovative programs and a deep commitment to rural health care who were simply not able to sustain their work because health care payment models that were designed for urban places didn’t take rural realities into account.

# Upcoming Events
---
#### August 20, 5:00-6:30 PM - Watertown Fundraiser
---
I’m looking forward to being in Watertown tonight for a fundraiser at Dempsey’s Brewery. Join us for a chance to connect, talk about what’s at stake in this election, and help us continue building a campaign that reaches every corner of South Dakota.
---
#### August 21, 5:00-7:00 PM - Charles Mix County Fundraiser
---
Friday evening, I’ll be in Wagner at the American Legion for a fundraiser with friends and supporters in Charles Mix County. I’m looking forward to spending time in the community, hearing what’s on people’s minds, and talking about how we can bring experienced, accountable leadership back to South Dakota.
---
#### August 22, 9:30-11:00 AM - Riverboat Days Parade
---
I’ll be in Yankton Saturday morning for the Riverboat Days Parade! I’m excited to join the community for one of Yankton’s biggest annual traditions and spend the morning with folks from across the area. Keep an eye out for us along the parade route and be sure to say hello.
---
#### August 25, 5:30-7:30 PM - Brule County Picnic
---
I’ll be joining folks in Brule County on Tuesday for the Brule County Picnic. I’m looking forward to another opportunity to visit with South Dakotans, hear about what matters in their communities, and enjoy some time together as we continue traveling across the state.

Peter, Last month I wrote to you about **Maj. Jason Watson** , the active-duty Air Force officer arrested on the Capitol steps for calling on Congress to impeach Donald Trump. This week he sat down with CNN for his first interview since that day. He said this president is violating the Constitution, that the Iran war is an unconstitutional war of choice, and that Americans are dying because of the decisions one man keeps making. **For bravely speaking the truth he was arrested again and is sitting in custody right now. ** [**We need to stop the betrayals of the veterans and active-duty servicemembers this administration keeps grinding down. Watson has laid on the line, because I spent 20 years in the same Air Force he did. Watson has 17 years in and sits three short of a _full pension. _ A pension is the security you promised your family in exchange for two decades of missed birthdays and deployments. He is risking all of it, plus his freedom, because he believes his oath demands it. In an administration full of generals and secretaries who bent the knee to keep their jobs, one major decided his conscience outranked his career.

**The SC Legislature passed a budget. Communities lost the most with no earmarks.**
South Carolina state government has been operating under a continuing resolution since July 1 because the legislature was unable to finalize a spending plan before the start of the new fiscal year.
Budget writers set aside $377.7 million for lawmaker projects in a separate piece of legislation. They gave themselves a Sept. 30 deadline to allocate the money, but lawmakers would have had to come back in the fall to approve a supplemental spending bill, which risks the possibility of negative headlines on certain projects less than two months before the November election.
Budget negotiators had agreed to have a joint committee decide how much money each earmark received. That went out the window as budget writers tried to resolve earmark funding before Tuesday’s session, and communities are the ones who will lose the most.[ Read more here.](https://us.list-manage.com/FjBpkxmDbCI?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)

The Democratic Socialists of America held their national convention. And here's what one of their newly elected congressional candidates said when he arrived:

_**"We're beating establishment candidates."**_
He's not wrong. DSA-backed candidates have knocked off long-serving Democrats in Colorado and Pennsylvania this cycle. They now have nearly 90 candidates running in 2026 federal races. And their platform calls for:

* Medicare for All (government-run healthcare, private insurance eliminated)
* A $25 federal minimum wage
* Free college
* The Green New Deal (which would devastate Ohio's energy sector)
* Abolish ICE
* Universal Basic Income (government checks for everyone, working or not)
