clean_body: The Democratic Socialists of America just held their national convention — and one of their newly elected congressmen said "We're beating establishment candidates." | Fellow Conservative, The Democratic Socialists of America held their national convention. And here's what one of their newly elected congressional candidates said when he arrived: "We're beating establishment candidates." He's not wrong. DSA-backed candidates have knocked off long-serving Democrats in Colorado and Pennsylvania this cycle. They now have nearly 90 candidates running in 2026 federal races. And their platform calls for: Medicare for All (government-run healthcare, private insurance eliminated) A $25 federal minimum wage Free college The Green New Deal (which would devastate Ohio's energy sector) Abolish ICE Universal Basic Income (government checks for everyone, working or not) | Now here's where it gets personal. My opponent in Ohio's 15th District, Don Leonard, wants you to think he has nothing to do with any of this. He's not a socialist, he says. Nothing to worry about. Except he said something else on a podcast, earlier this year. When asked about democratic socialism, here's what he actually said: "I am not a democratic socialist. Even if I were, I'd lie to the people of my district in order to get their votes." He said that. Out loud. With a laugh. This is the person the DCCC is backing to flip this seat. A former Ohio State professor who donated to the Bernie Sanders-backed Working Families Party, wrote an academic paper calling for a socialist "counter-movement" in America, praised Squad member Summer Lee's response to President Trump's State of the Union, and called to "replace ICE completely." But don't worry...... he says he's not a socialist. And if he were, he'd just lie about it. For Ohio, Mike Carey Congressman, OH-15 | | Paid for by Carey for Congress P.O. body:
| |

Y'all know that I have Republicans, Independents, and Democrats donating to this campaign because they trust I'm going to DC to work for them, not play whatever kind of politics this is from Tim.
---
|
---
His email is exactly the same kind of fear-mongering, pretending-to-be-an-outsider nonsense from the only candidate in this race that's actually making nice with the "Swamp crowd." Remember, [Tim takes corporate PAC money](https://clicksp.michaelafortennessee.com/f/a/2YNsI75sh6_cNzKEF92gqg~~/AAPPABA~/iehbOZaTtMm0XGR0vkX8l9Un5PLb39oUzuI1L8KQQ57yV9dozKSG6388C43aG5Qls13DzK16ExGHbmzYgRVK9pi-nxbiU1lvFJp_ptmPvLPf4eZtrFXhh3kec_lPxTuuJ6YQ6QgkcM_6DSCyqUbtrRH_Ig77PI6s8mY4Jt9RvWBTxfTY2Bk620XmoT1jpdHjskzZVVv8c840YXXHpYt7BLRuUvcg7HJ8YqZbAHZlzrwv06MmPJZcwas04ghrEGA48PjC_Itf9e4lcGno0_E9Am4C1smdaoDoS51aKRqJaOo~), and I do not. Friends, is it radical to believe that the government should work for us, not just corporate interests, career politicians, and to fund foreign wars? Is it radical to believe that we should work for affordable, accessible healthcare? Radical to want to invest in our nation and region's infrastructure? Radical to want East Tennesseans to have good jobs, high wages, and to be able to afford groceries, transportation, medication, and housing? Radical to hold open town halls so those you seek to represent can ask you tough questions? # MEMORANDUM

To: Valued Supporters
From: Team Lily
Date: August 20, 2026
Re: Lily4Congress Committee STAKEHOLDER UPDATE | AUGUST 2026
**THE STATE OF THE RACE** Lily Tang Williams enters the closing months of the 2026 campaign with growing financial strength, expanding national visibility, and a grassroots organization built to compete across New Hampshire’s Second Congressional District. The contrast in the Republican primary is increasingly clear: Lily is building the organization, resources, and grassroots infrastructure necessary to win the primary and immediately take the fight to Maggie Goodlander in November. Meanwhile, Lily’s Republican primary opponent is reporting a negative cash-on-hand position and has raised questions about his campaign’s accounting practices following his first FEC filing.
**FUNDRAISING: BUILDING THE RESOURCES TO WIN** Lily’s fundraising continues to demonstrate the strength and breadth of support behind her campaign. The campaign has raised over $1 million this cycle, mainly from grassroots supporters, giving Lily the resources to continue expanding voter contact, communications, and campaign infrastructure as Election Day approaches. The financial contrast in the primary is significant. Lily’s opponent has reported negative cash-on-hand as of the last filing, putting himself in a decidedly weak position. Thus, every dollar Lily raises and preserves during the primary strengthens our ability to immediately pivot toward the larger objective: defeating Maggie Goodlander in November.
**BUILDING THE TEAM TO WIN** Our fundraising momentum is translating directly into campaign infrastructure. The campaign has recently made two new staff hires, expanding our capacity as we accelerate field and voter-contact operations, communications, and additional fundraising heading into the final stretch. Just as importantly, Lily’s campaign has assembled the largest grassroots volunteer team for a Republican campaign in NH-02 since Congressman Charlie Bass held the seat in 2012. That organization is giving Lily something money alone cannot buy: an energized network of Granite Staters willing to knock doors, make calls, attend events, recruit supporters, and carry Lily’s message into their own communities.
**NATIONAL ATTENTION: LILY’S STORY REACHES A LARGER AUDIENCE** Lily recently joined Tim Pool for an extended national podcast interview, bringing her story, message, and campaign to a major national audience. Lily can speak firsthand about growing up under Communist rule in China, coming to America with little, building a successful life, and becoming an outspoken defender of individual liberty and the American Dream. Long-form national interviews give supporters the opportunity to hear Lily tell that story directly, in her own words, while explaining what is at stake in this election and why she is running for Congress.
**GRASSROOTS: THE “ASK ME ANYTHING” TOWN HALL SERIES** At home in New Hampshire, Lily has launched her “Ask Me Anything” Town Hall Series—open forums where Granite Staters can ask Lily directly about the issues that matter to them. The series reflects a central principle of Lily’s campaign: accessibility. Rather than relying on scripted appearances, Lily is putting herself directly in front of voters, taking questions, listening to concerns, and making the case for change. Thus far, Lily has held town halls in Windham, Brookline, Weare, and West Lebanon. The series is aggressively continuing across the district as the campaign expands its grassroots presence and voter outreach.
**THE ROAD AHEAD** The campaign has built the foundation necessary for victory: a significant financial advantage in the Republican primary, two new staff hires, the strongest Republican grassroots volunteer organization in NH-02 since Charlie Bass held the seat, growing national exposure, and a candidate willing to go anywhere and answer any question. The primary presents a clear contrast between a campaign building the financial and organizational strength required for November and one that can’t get out of the gate. Now we must turn that strength into votes. Every additional dollar means more doors knocked, more voters contacted, more advertising and communications, and a stronger organization ready to pivot immediately toward Maggie Goodlander after the primary. Lily has the story, the organization, and the momentum. Our job now is to make sure every voter in New Hampshire’s Second Congressional District hears her message.

Donald Trump wants your
name. Your DOB. Your address. Your driver's license number. And the last
four digits of your SSN. Simply because you're registered to vote.

One of his executive orders demanded every state hand over its entire
voter roll — millions of Americans' private data — to the federal
government.

Thirty states and D.C. said no. So Trump’s DOJ sued them all.

Judges have blocked his power grab 22 times. But that’s not enough for
Trump. His loyalist Attorney General, Todd Blanche, just said taking this
fight to the Supreme Court is "absolutely" a possibility.^1

Before he was Attorney General, Blanche was Trump's personal lawyer — he
defended Trump through 34 felony convictions. Now he runs the DOJ, and
he's the one deciding whether to ask the Supreme Court to override 22
rulings and hand Trump the voter data he couldn't get any other way.

This is about control. Trump is using the DOJ he's turned into a personal
weapon to get his hands on every American's voter data to interfere in the
midterm elections and cement his grip on power before voters can push
back.

We're not sitting on the sidelines. Demand Justice PAC is fighting to
expose this corruption and hold the DOJ accountable. But we can't do it
without you.

subject: Stop the Democrats' Income Tax Scheme Before It's Too Late
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Granite Solutions
body:
| No income tax. No sales tax. That's the NH Advantage — and it's under attack right now. | |
---
THE NH ADVANTAGE IS UNDER ATTACK
Derek, No income tax. No sales tax. That's the New Hampshire Advantage — and it's the reason families and small businesses choose to build their lives here instead of Massachusetts. But Democrats in Concord won't stop scheming to take it away. Every session, they float new ways to open the door: "temporary" taxes, "targeted" taxes, taxes with friendly-sounding names. They know they can't pass an income tax outright — so they try to sneak it in piece by piece. We've all seen how this ends. Once an income tax gets a foothold, it never shrinks. It only grows. Just ask anyone who fled Massachusetts to get here. Granite Solutions PAC exists to stop them. We're funding the digital ads, mail, and grassroots outreach it takes to expose every income tax scheme before it gains traction — and to hold accountable the politicians pushing them. | The NH Advantage wasn't handed to us. It was defended — year after year, fight after fight. Now it's our turn.
---
Here's the truth: we can't match the out-of-state money flooding into New Hampshire to push these tax schemes. But we don't have to. We just need enough Granite Staters chipping in to keep our message in front of voters.
**Even 25 funds another round of digital ads reaching New Hampshire voters with the truth about what an income tax would cost their family.**
Will you chip in right now to protect the NH Advantage?

subject: Big news from me
body:
The independent analysts at the Cook Political Report shifted this race in our favor.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, I want you to hear this breaking news directly from me:
**This morning, the independent political analysts at the _Cook Political Report_ shifted the Texas governor’s race in our favor.**
This comes just two days after _Fox News_ shifted their Texas Power Rankings towards Democrats, referring to our race to unseat Greg Abbott as “clearly competitive.”
Poll after poll – and rating change after rating change – confirms the momentum is on our side. **Today, that became undeniable.**
This shift confirms what I’ve been seeing and hearing on the ground: Texans are ready to put an end to Abbott’s reign once and for all. I believe we will win if we can spread our message in these final 75 days until Election Day. But that all depends on what we can raise in pivotal moments like right now.
[**Please rush an urgent donation of $5 or more to help our campaign respond to this rating change and power our GOTV efforts in this final stretch. There has never been a more important moment for our campaign to see a surge in fundraising than today.**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260820_2_cookpolitical.gD_f-t&refcode=em20260820-1884&amount=5&t=1&akid=1884%2E299639%2Eo_rANJ)
If you only read one piece of political news today, please let it be this direct quote from the analysts at the Cook Political Report:
_“Republicans privately acknowledge that this could become a real race. Hinojosa still needs to raise substantially more money to be truly competitive come November.”_
Greg Abbott is losing his grip on Texas. He knows it, Republican strategists know it, and you and I know it, too. **But the only way this race stays in play is if we can close the massive fundraising deficit we have against Abbott.**
We don’t have to match his spending dollar for dollar – we just need to raise enough to execute our strategy to mobilize the Texas voters we know will break in our favor.
**[I know I come to you often to ask, but your support has never been more important than it is today. – Gina

Israeli soldiers and settlers have been besieging three Palestinian families in their homes in the village of Qusra in the occupied West Bank since August 9. Photo on August 14, 2026 by Issam Rimawi/Anadolu via Getty Images.
RAMALLAH, Occupied West Bank--For the 12th consecutive day, three Palestinian families, comprising 10 people, including two young children, have been trapped inside their homes in the occupied West Bank, besieged and terrorized by dozens of armed Israelis--both settlers and soldiers. The family members have been stuck in separate homes, unable to shelter together or attend to their basic needs, with food supplies running dangerously low and without access to cooking gas or a fridge.
While the siege on the three families has garnered international media attention and statements of condemnation, the attack is not the first of its kind, but rather a more prominent example of a growing tactic by Israeli settlers and soldiers working in tandem to dispossess Palestinians from their homes in the West Bank. The attacks are increasingly focused on Palestinian communities in Area B, a designation under the Oslo Accords where the Palestinian Authority is nominally in charge of civil administration while Israel retains security control.
The latest Israeli siege targeted a small cluster of Palestinian homes that sit atop a hill on the edge of the village of Qusra, in the southern part of the Nablus governorate in the northern West Bank.
On the morning of August 9, armed settlers blocked off the only road leading to the homes and erected a colonial outpost directly in front of the door of one of the houses. They began pelting the homes with rocks and trying to break inside on a regular basis.
Israeli occupation forces eventually arrived on the scene and removed the outpost, but the settlers were able to erect it again, a pattern that repeated several times. And despite brief clashes with Israeli forces, the settlers were allowed to remain and continued to roam the area freely.
The settlers also cut off access to water and electricity and for more than a week prevented anyone--including emergency workers or ambulances--from reaching the families trapped inside. Qusra municipality employees were eventually allowed to repair the water and electricity lines after being initially assaulted by settlers and detained by Israeli forces.
Israeli troops have also exacerbated the situation by occupying two of the Palestinian homes they claim to be protecting.
On August 14, soldiers forced Yousef and Ruqayya Hassan and their two daughters, four-year-old Kinda and two-year-old Hour, from their home and into their neighbor's unfinished villa, which belongs to Loui Abu Ridi, a U.S. citizen. Still unfinished, Abu Ridi's home lacked basic furniture, including beds.
"It feels like there was a death in the family. We're all distressed, angry and in a state of sadness," Ruqayya told Drop Site in a phone interview.
Israeli troops occupied another neighboring home that was still under construction and belonged to Abou Ridi's brother, Raed. The soldiers also erected a tent around twelve meters away, according to the mayor of Qusra, Abdelatheem Wadi.
"It's the armed settlers on one hand and the military on the other," Wadi told Drop Site, characterizing the trapped families in Qusra as being under a "double siege."
Meanwhile, Ruqayya's daughters fell ill and started exhibiting flu-like symptoms, with a fluctuating fever and a heavy cough. On the afternoon of August 12, Ruqayya and both her daughters were allowed to temporarily evacuate from the area in an ambulance to a medical clinic for treatment. It was when she and her daughters returned to the besieged area two days later that they found Israeli soldiers occupying their home and were ordered to move into Abu Ridi's.
Another home belongs to Ruqayya's brother-in-law, Rizq Hassan, who is trapped inside along with his 61-year-old mother and sister. The Israeli military has separated the families and prevented them from seeing each other.
"My daughters keep asking me why their teta (grandmother) is right next door and yet they can't be with her. They are very distressed. How on earth can I explain what's happening to them?" Ruqayya, adding that the psychological and physical toll was already visible in her eldest daughter. "Kinda has started urinating involuntarily. Even during the day, when she's awake, she wets herself," she said.
## **" Complete Siege"**
The fact that Abou Ridi, a U.S. citizen, was the owner of one of the homes may have helped spark statements of condemnation, including from staunchly pro-Israel U.S. officials like Ambassador Mike Huckabee, who called the settlers "Israeli terrorists" and their actions "criminal," though Washington did nothing to intervene. Abou Ridi traveled from Ohio back to Palestine on August 17 to join his brother Qusai and his nephew who were staying in his home along with Ruqayya, her husband, and two daughters.
Those staying in Abou Ridi's home eventually received supplies of food, water, and medicine from a [UNICEF team on August 17](https://substack.com/redirect/f055728a-f292-4d98-8519-907df807ac40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), as well as personal care supplies for Ruqayya and her daughters. Those in Rizq Hassan's home, which is under less of a spotlight, were not as fortunate.
"My brother-in-law's home is under complete siege. They're not allowed to leave the front door. They don't have gas, or a fridge--they're living on bread and a few canned items," said Ruqayya. "No one is talking about them."
Wadi, the mayor, said they are being abused by soldiers. "The aid brought in by UNICEF to Rizq Hassan's home was left by soldiers in the yard for 24 hours in the sun, before the family was allowed to receive it, and half of it was already ruined," Wadi told Drop Site. "There is media attention only on Loui's home."
The military and settler siege expanded beyond the three homes on August 13, when hundreds of Israeli occupation soldiers [stormed Qusra](https://substack.com/redirect/7a1e71f3-7e0f-403d-94f7-e30a7d84e583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and imposed a curfew across the entire village. Soldiers took over at least eight homes and forced their families out. According to Wadi, they severely vandalized the houses, damaging furniture and belongings.
The soldiers withdrew days later from the eight homes and the rest of the village, but they declared the area of the three besieged homes a closed military zone. Wadi estimates at least 50 to 60 soldiers remain stationed in and around the area of the besieged homes.
While the military claimed this order would be over by Tuesday evening, it remains in place, according to the residents.

## **" The New Reality"**
Palestinians in the occupied West Bank have been coming under a steadily escalating assault for the past three years. Israeli settler attacks backed by Israeli soldiers and the state have fully or partially displaced 107 communities since January 2023, alongside unprecedented settlement expansion, according to a new report by Human Rights Watch. The Israeli military expelled another 32,000 Palestinians from their homes in the Jenin, Tulkarem, and Nur Shams camps in January 2025.
The besieged families in Qusra have been under assault [since January](https://substack.com/redirect/e8d99f66-6d11-4135-a26e-ea25c0585e31?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), when settlers first took over a nearby building that was under-construction and began launching daily attacks on the residents.
Their homes lie in Area B of the occupied West Bank. While settler attacks and the forcible transfer of Palestinians in recent years have largely targeted villages and Bedouin communities in Area C--which comprises roughly 60% of the West Bank and includes almost all the agricultural land--Israeli settler violence and theft of land is now increasingly spreading into Palestinian communities located in Area B.
Last month, a Palestinian family of eight living in the nearby village of Jalud, were [forced from their home](https://substack.com/redirect/a11c9556-8930-4814-92f0-1ff731d28c0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after a similar 10-day settler and soldier siege. The concentrated attack began three months prior, when settlers erected a colonial outpost near the Al-Tubassi family and began targeting them on a daily basis.
"During the final month, the settlers occupied a house under construction on the road to the Al-Tubassi family home, and in the last 10 days they cut off the water, electricity and no one could reach them any more," Bashar Qaryouti, a medic and activist in the area, told Drop Site. "In the last four days the family had no food, nothing left, and on the final day they were held at gunpoint by the settlers and forced to leave."
In a [statement](https://substack.com/redirect/7a4f391b-2243-4f9c-9754-c39bf42ee9e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) last week, the UN Human Rights Office condemned the attacks on Qusra. "These criminal actions by the settlers, supported or acquiesced to by Israel, the Occupying Power, are making life unbearable for these Palestinian families, and are clearly aimed at forcing them to leave their homes and land. Time is running out for these three families before they are forcibly displaced," the UN Human Rights Office said. "The International Court of Justice is clear that all Israeli settlements are illegal and that Israel is obligated to cease all settlement activities, evacuate all settlers, including those terrorizing Qusra and Jalud, and bring to an end its unlawful presence in the West Bank."
Analysts also warn that the recurrence of the siege tactic in Qusra is ominous and points to a wider pattern unfolding across the occupied West Bank.
"It began with Bedouin Palestinians in the remote areas, then it moved to the small villages at the edges of the governorates, and now they are in large villages, with the active participation of the military, which also supplies the weapons and trains them," Ramallah-based political analyst Nihad Abu Ghosh told Drop Site.
Tens of thousands of Palestinians have been forcibly transferred by settlers and the military from Area C over the past three years. In addition to the thousand of Palestinians forcibly displaced over the past three years in the West Bank, over 1,000 Palestinians have also been killed, nearly a quarter of them children.
"These are fascist, Jewish-Zionist militias who are carrying out pogroms and killings in the occupied West Bank," continued Abu Ghosh. "Both the government and the settlers are in a race against time. They consider the few remaining months or days of this government's tenure to be an exceptional opportunity to change the reality on the ground. That is why they are intensifying their attacks until they reach a point where, in their assessment, it will be difficult to reverse what they have done."
Conditions for Palestinians in the occupied West Bank deteriorated even further last month after a large-scale settler attack on the village of Tel, southwest of Nablus city, on July 24, during which four Palestinians and two Israeli settlers were killed.
Since the incident in Tel, settlers and soldiers have carried out daily, round-the-clock attacks, including mass shootings, physical assaults, arson, and land theft. Settlers have also erected at least 15 new colonial outposts on Palestinian land across the West Bank, with the vocal backing of top Israeli officials, including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/067dd3f1-e212-42ae-aa89-a5a36ed5abed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a series of steps that included "accelerating the legalization of farm outposts and establishment of new ones."
Back in Qusra, residents are terrified.
"I keep thinking about what happened to the Al-Tubassi family and praying that we can outlast this," said Ruqayya.
Wadi, the Qusra mayor, is equally concerned. "We fear that this siege will become the new reality in the occupied West Bank, that Qusra will be another precedent for all the villages," Wadi said. He also recounted that his older brother and nephew were murdered by armed settlers on October 12, 2023, during a funeral for four other Palestinians killed in the village also by settlers the prior day.
Some warn that the unrelenting settler-colonial violence may be reaching a tipping point. "The distance between the Palestinian people in the West Bank and massacres, is a question of when--not if," said Abu Ghosh. "When the knife reaches the throats of Palestinians, they will have no choice but to resist with whatever means are available to them."

Peter,
A campaign finance complaint in Pennsylvania alleges that MAGA influencer Scott Presler and his group Early Vote Action (EVA) raised and spent significant amounts of money to try and defeat three Democratic state supreme court justices -- and failed to disclose any of their donors or their spending.
If you don't know Presler, or don't remember him from our successful 2025 campaign to stop him and MAGA from flipping the Pennsylvania Supreme Court, here's a refresher:

* Presler is a close Trump ally and constantly spreads disinformation about voting and elections, accusing Democrats of fraud without evidence and voicing insane conspiracies that fuel MAGA's darkest ambitions

* In 2016, Presler was banned from working with the Republican Party after he allegedly posted sexually explicit photos of himself in a Virginia RNC office on Craigslist

* We know from federal filings that Presler's Early Vote Action received $1 million from Elon Musk and multiple large donations from alleged sex trafficker Tristan Tate

| | | | | | This past week, our city has seen historic levels of rainfall and flooding that have harmed so many in our community. So I’m asking that we all pitch in to help our neighbors, however we can.
There are several organizations that could use our help, including our money, time, and resources. If you are able to help, please reach out either to us or directly to the organizations below.

[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/XZACBhkJy5Z?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8)
| | [**Indiana 211**](https://us.list-manage.com/14Fal9HC1Bg?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) : Dial 2-1-1 to get connected with local health and human service resources. Anyone can use the service for help with food, housing, utility bills, and health care.
[**Indy’s Flood Resource Page**](https://us.list-manage.com/YXbUKyGHbbU?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) : This hub gives access to current recovery resources and updates. From there, you can get connected to agencies and groups that can assist you.

[**Community Resources Database**](https://us.list-manage.com/IpsxRD3gjgf?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) : This database provides you with contact information for organizations that can assist you, organized by your needs.
[**Report Flood Damage**](https://us.list-manage.com/NgK5UNG6oQK?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) : Help the city know the extent of flood damage to better track where resources need to go. This is not an application for assistance.
[**Ravenswood Community Updates**](https://us.list-manage.com/9qasF69Qb9G?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) : Join the community Facebook group for the latest updates on resources, volunteering, and news.
[**Red Cross Shelters**](https://us.list-manage.com/WPe2vqSg7js?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) : Find open shelters or disaster relief services if you have been forced to evacuate your home, or don’t have access to essential services.
[**Affidavit for Replacement of SNAP Benefits**](https://us.list-manage.com/3LZ6Nb9uHUN?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) : If you have lost food that was purchased with SNAP benefits, you can report that loss and be reimbursed. Your application must be submitted within 10 days of the triggering event.
[**Community Compass**](https://us.list-manage.com/N_v9j6z0O_4?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) : If you or someone you know is in need of food, you can use the Community Compass website to locate services near you.
[**Indy Animal Care Services**](https://us.list-manage.com/Je5vHbJU0WT?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) : If you need supplies or food for your pets, or a lost pet that you find, Indy’s Animal Care Services site can help you find organizations willing to help.
[**Salvation Army of Indy Locations**](https://us.list-manage.com/NhJADq79mtC?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) : You can find your nearest Salvation Army Indy location to get help with finding what you may need.

[**Mirror Indy Resource Page**](https://us.list-manage.com/2Ns7Fw_QWYE?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) : They have provided an up-to-date page dedicated to where you can find shelter, food, clothes, and pet supplies for yourself and your family, friends, and neighbors.
Thank you all for your dedication to our neighbors. We, united together, will emerge stronger.

clean_body: Try this week’s Wood You Know >>| | | | | | Dear Peter, Our new forest guessing game tests your photographic knowledge of lesser seen parts of the redwood forest. This week we’re getting a little wild. Redwood forests aren’t just home to the towering giants we know and love. These ecosystems are teeming with life. There are even some wildlife species that can only be found among the redwoods. The redwood ecosystem is something special, with each snail, slug, salmon, or squirrel having their role to play. Everything works in harmony—and every single piece is worth protecting. With every acre of redwood forest we conserve and restore, Save the Redwoods is also preserving the wildlife habitats that these many amazing creatures depend on. Protecting the redwoods means protecting every creature that lives among them. | | | | | Good luck! Laura LalemandSenior Scientist | | | P.S. Fellow Patriot,

**Democrats in Florida just nominated a self-proclaimed socialist in the biggest Senate special election of 2026.**
_**Her name is Angie Nixon. ** _
She publicly and proudly joined the Democratic Socialists of America during her campaign.
She’s a former “community organizer” who literally runs a bookstore called Cafe Resistance.
She’s endorsed by The Squad and held one of her final rallies with Hamas superfan Rashida Tlaib.
**And she just defeated an incredibly well-funded Democrat with a nearly $17 million war chest** _**by more than ten points after raising less than a million dollars.** _
This is not a fringe candidate who stumbled into a nomination. And the socialist movement gobbling up seats all across the country can no longer be excused as some obscure “wing” of the Democratic Party.
**The heart and soul and energy of the Democrats is now with the socialists, and with the support of President Trump and patriots all across the nation, I’m ready to bury this twisted ideology in Florida.**
You and I love this country. We love freedom, the rule of law, and the belief that hard work and responsibility matter. We do not get up every day and work hard, raise our families and build our communities just to see the evil and failed socialist ideology destroy everything we love.

# Many Thanks and What’s Next

Peter,Wow! Gotta say that watching the election results come in last Tuesday was rather exhilarating. As some may recall, there was a point when all three of us were neck-and-neck:
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | While we ultimately did not prevail, we did win 7 counties – Polk, St. Croix, Barron, Burnett, Chippewa, Monroe, and Jackson – with Barron County coming in with a 17% margin!**I couldn’t be more proud of what we accomplished together.** We had the least amount of resources (but the best supporters and volunteers!) and what we achieved was quite remarkable! I am humbled that over 20,000 people cast their vote for our agenda.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

Of course, it’s all because of your unwavering support, generous financial contributions, and the relentless passion of volunteers who gave it their all. Your commitment fueled my determination as I criss-crossed the district over the last 16 months.**But, our work is not finished.** Our mission remains the same – we must flip the 7th District and ensure that Tom Tiffany does not become governor. I’ve spoken with Fred and assured him that I would do all that I can to support his campaign. Similarly, we must support David Crowley in his bid to become our next governor.That being said, I remain committed to our goals: the federal government needs to follow the law and the Constitution and get back to working for the people.
* Trump and his criminal, corrupt cabinet must be impeached and removed from office.
* ICE must be abolished.
* The illegal war in Iran must be stopped.
* Affordable healthcare is a right we all deserve.
* We must protect our environment for future generations at all costs.

[**HELP US COVER LAST MINUTE EXPENSES**](https://us.list-manage.com/pAgGOfqOO2T?e=0c0d11993f&c2id=6a676d78c90e8a1f5821c8d4ac39abd8)**What’s Next?** Last week I visited the St. Croix and Polk County Dems to express my gratitude and commitment to continue the fight. This week I’ll be at Chippewa and Barron Counties for the same. And this coming Tuesday, August 25th, I’ll be on [Walter Rhein’s podcast](https://us.list-manage.com/vlO7FzsUIpF?e=0c0d11993f&c2id=6a676d78c90e8a1f5821c8d4ac39abd8) at 9am for a bit of retrospection and thoughts on where we go from here.I’ll probably take a little time off – perhaps get in mini-camping vacation in the next couple of weeks – and catch up on all the household and work priorities that have been on the back burner for many months. While it’s tempting to return to our regularly scheduled programming, we can’t stay on the sidelines very long.Have a great weekend, thanks for all your support, and stay tuned for next steps!Thanks, Chris ~:|

We talk power, addiction, forgiveness, family, and what it means to fight back when the rules--and the people enforcing them--have completely failed us. * * *
Hey folks,
I sat down with [Hunter Biden](https://open.substack.com/users/401188266-hunter-biden?utm_source=mentions) , and this one went places I didn't expect. We talked Trump, Natalie Harp, accountability, addiction, forgiveness, being the family fuck-up--and what it actually takes to own your story when the whole world thinks it gets to define you.
It gets political. It gets personal. And by the end, it gets deeply human.
* [**00:03:36**] Hunter and I dive into the bizarre Natalie Harp story, the hypocrisy surrounding it, and why questions about access to the president are absolutely fair game.
* [**00:10:00**] We get into the "zero gravity" problem in Washington--where lies get amplified, accountability disappears, and everyone acts like the normal rules still apply.
* [**00:19:03**] This is where it gets personal. Hunter talks about addiction, shame, being the person who screwed up in the family, and why owning your story can become a source of real power.
* [**00:28:31**] Hunter makes the case for building a much bigger coalition--even with people we strongly disagree with--when the immediate fight is protecting democracy and the rule of law.
* [**00:34:30**] Hunter gives an emotional update on his dad's cancer treatment and talks about what it's like, simply as a son, to watch someone you love go through something this hard.

There's a lot packed into this conversation, but what stayed with me most is the humanity of it. How do we fight like hell without losing our capacity for forgiveness? How do we hold people accountable while recognizing the struggles that connect so many of us? And how do we stop letting other people weaponize our worst moments against us? **If you value honest conversations like this --the political and the deeply personal--help me keep them going.**

With urgency,
--Mike

body:
Three laws, one result: A federal suit says Colorado and Denver leave some visitors no way to carry
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hey friends,
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
Here's a summary of today's top stories:
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** An NRA-backed lawsuit argues Colorado's carry-permit rules and Denver's open-carry ban [leave visitors no legal way to carry a handgun](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Democratic socialist Melat Kiros, who unseated Rep. Diana DeGette, faces [distance from some fellow Democrats](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) despite backing from Sens. Hickenlooper and Bennet. [Rural hospitals face severe strain](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with 75% on unsustainable margins. And Rep. [Lorena Garcia funneled nonprofit money](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to help qualify Initiative 195, which would replace the flat tax with a graduated rate up to 8.4%.
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...**[U.S. manufacturing hit a four-year high](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in July, with the PMI at 55.6, boosted partly by AI-driven tech demand. And a new site, [HaveIBeenFlocked.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), lets drivers check if their plate was searched in Flock Safety's camera network.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** Brian Joondeph criticized [Denver's proposed slavery "acknowledgment" ritual](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as costless symbolism ignoring real problems. Connor Boyack highlighted Fauci's newly released diaries, showing [his fixation on fame and a prize-solicitation scheme](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) tied to a grantee's half-billion dollars in NIH funding. And Patrice Onwuka argued Sanders' food-label bill would [raise grocery costs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) without improving kids' health.
This is your Mountain Minute for Thursday, August 20, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Three laws, one result: A federal suit says Colorado and Denver leave some visitors no way to carry](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
He says he passed a background check stricter than Colorado’s. He holds a carry permit that is good in more than 30 states. He owns a second home in Weld County. And when Greg Howeth applied for a Colorado permit this spring, a Weld County employee called to tell him no — because he does not have a Colorado ID.
That denial, delivered by email on May 28, is now Exhibit 2 in a federal lawsuit against the City and County of Denver, Colorado Attorney General Phil Weiser, and five other officials.
Howeth, a South Carolina man named Zackary Dougherty, and the National Rifle Association filed the case in U.S. District Court in Denver on Aug. 12.
Their claim is not that any single Colorado law is unconstitutional. It is that three of them, stacked together, leave visitors like Howeth and Dougherty with no legal way to carry a handgun in Denver.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[The cheap politics of acknowledgment: Joondeph’s case against Denver’s plan](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [AMERICAN THINKER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Dr. Brian Joondeph argues Denver's proposed slavery acknowledgment is symbolic theater that solves nothing while real problems go unaddressed._
* **A ritual with no obvious purpose:** Denver's City Council is considering adding a labor acknowledgment recognizing slavery and its legacy before official meetings, even though Colorado entered the Union in 1876 as a free state, more than a decade after the Civil War ended.
* **Acknowledgment without action, Joondeph argues:** Drawing a parallel to church land acknowledgments that never lead to actually returning property, he contends these rituals — like Denver's renaming of Mount Evans to Mount Blue Sky and Stapleton to Central Park — cost nothing and demand no sacrifice, unlike genuinely addressing crime, homelessness, or failing schools
* **A slippery slope of historical grievances:** Joondeph warns that if governments start reciting every historical atrocity before conducting business, there's no logical stopping point, and argues Denver residents care far more about functioning city services than symbolic statements about the past.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

Their metro district levied 115.019 mills in 2024, good for fifth place on a list of eleven districts statewide charging 100 mills or more. That levy pulled in $428,566 in property taxes for the year._

subject: August DNC Coalitions Newsletter
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/c0d14e94540c/august-coalitions-newsletter-2713282?e=d6c5c7d7ec)
---
| |
---
|
---
|
# DNC Coalitions Newsletter
---
| | “With [less than] 100 days left until the most important midterm elections of our lives, Democrats throughout the country are all gas, no brakes. We are pounding the pavement and continuing to do the work that wins elections — from registering voters and signing up new volunteers to knocking on doors, making phone calls, and hosting hundreds of events. We are organizing everywhere, fighting for every vote, and making the investments necessary to win up and down the ballot.” - [DNC Chair Ken Martin](https://us.list-manage.com/44A1F2V2YNw?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e)
---
|
---
|
# Election Highlights
---
| **Alaska**
* [Mary Peltola](https://us.list-manage.com/8ARtESkXGdo?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) advanced to the general election for U.S. Senate in Alaska.
* [Tom Begich and Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins](https://us.list-manage.com/CshNPVasNMd?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) have advanced to the general election for governor of Alaska

**Arizona**
* For the first time in 36 years, Democrats have flipped Chandler, AZ, electing [Matt Orlando](https://us.list-manage.com/APcOXNt44y2?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) as the city’s next mayor.

**Florida**
* [Angie Nixon](https://us.list-manage.com/62L2baHfLxs?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate in Florida.
* [David Jolly](https://us.list-manage.com/pTmEvNiyLUL?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) is the Democratic nominee for governor of Florida.
* Democrat [Moné Holder](https://us.list-manage.com/Kpnxljc2X1y?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won an at-large seat on the Jacksonville City Council, flipping the seat blue in Florida’s largest city.
* [Democrats in Florida won control of the Sarasota County school board](https://us.list-manage.com/ZFgW6HZuB97?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e), flipping two seats in a county that voted for Trump by 18 points. Moms for Liberty co-founder Bridget Ziegler is the outgoing board chair.

**Kansas**
* [Adam Hamilton](https://us.list-manage.com/EhlgxmNZNLb?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the Kansas Democratic primary for U.S. Senate.
* [Cindy Holscher](https://us.list-manage.com/1B6Fg3w1Zkx?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the Democratic nomination for Kansas governor.

**Maine**
* [Troy Jackson](https://us.list-manage.com/xulVGBJMZOZ?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) was selected by Mainers as the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate. He will face Susan Collins in the November general election.

**Michigan**
* [Jocelyn Benson](https://us.list-manage.com/GPHECBc1AAF?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the Michigan Democratic primary with more votes than the entire Republican field combined.
* [Abdul El-Sayed](https://us.list-manage.com/3RkuL51Zpb4?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate in Michigan.

**Minnesota**
* [Peggy Flanagan](https://us.list-manage.com/EtszsByz3r5?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the Minnesota Democratic primary for U.S. Senate.
* [Amy Klobuchar](https://us.list-manage.com/a6iCIYMJ_3Y?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) clinched the Democratic nomination for governor of Minnesota.

**Pennsylvania**
* [Brandon Dukes](https://us.list-manage.com/HXnpOY09tVJ?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the special election for Pennsylvania House District 12, flipping the seat from red to blue.

**Tennessee**
* [Jerri Green](https://us.list-manage.com/98DWrXB0jp5?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the Democratic primary for governor of Tennessee.
* [Marquita Bradshaw](https://us.list-manage.com/4JKDBUGs7N1?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate in Tennessee.
* Democrats in Tennessee [secured control of the Montgomery County Commission](https://us.list-manage.com/A1uPY8gNTSZ?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) after flipping four seats. Democrats also won control of the Knox County School Board of Education after [Brandy Jenkins](https://us.list-manage.com/PBoiuW1gKDA?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) flipped a Republican stronghold blue.

**Wisconsin**
* [David Crowley](https://us.list-manage.com/T8ExSvOyC6C?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the Democratic primary for governor of Wisconsin.

**Wyoming**
* [James Byrd](https://us.list-manage.com/jVrvS38YJuy?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate in Wyoming.
* [Kenneth Casner](https://us.list-manage.com/g6ImiuITzsk?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) is officially the Democratic nominee for governor of Wyoming.

---
|
---
|
# Program Updates
---
|
---
| **We Touch Grass (And Here’s Why)** What does "organizing everywhere" really look like? National Coalitions Director Eddie Taveras recently broke it down in The Blue Print. Eddie emphasizes that true impact happens far from D.C. conference rooms—it's built at kitchen tables in Milwaukee, community centers in L.A. and Vegas, local union halls in Pennsylvania, and across Tribal nations. Read about how our coalitions are hitting the ground running.
---
| [Read More](https://us.list-manage.com/WeGtXkd8e7I?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e "Read More")
---
|
---
|
# **Get Out the Vote!**
The DNC is seeking experienced former campaigners to fill key Late Help roles in key battleground states for the 2026 elections to regain control of the U.S. House and Senate. Your experience matters greatly!

**KEY DETAILS**
* **Role Format:** Primarily in-person on the ground, with limited remote opportunities.
* **Experience:** Organizing, GOTV, Operations, Data, Voter Protection, IT, Comms.
* **Locations:** AZ, GA, MI, NC, NV, PA, WI, etc., with flexible options.

---
| [Sign Up](https://us.list-manage.com/GEX9NlD3xWi?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e "Sign Up")
---
|
---
|
# In Case You Missed It (ICYMI)
DNC Events
---
|
---
| **Southwest Know Your Rights Tour**
The DNC hosted two community Know Your Rights (KYR) events with Latino and AAPI partners in Los Angeles and Las Vegas to educate attendees about their voting and constitutional rights, encourage community members to participate in DNC programming, and uplift the stories of local community members affected by ICE.
---
|
---
|
---
| **Celebrating the Passage of the Americans with Disabilities Act**
---
|
---
| This summer, we celebrated the anniversary of the Americans with Disabilities Act by hosting a voting rights training for the disability community and poll workers. In partnership with New Disabled South Rising and the College Democrats of America Disability Caucus, we focused on ensuring accessibility at the ballot box. We also featured [Leslie in The Blue Print](https://us.list-manage.com/6WyvJKFL8ac?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e), where she discussed the importance of Disability Pride Month and the critical work ahead.
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| **Veteran and Military Families Engagement**
---
|
---
| The DNC has been honored to collaborate with veterans and military families. From a Midwestern Veterans Know Your Rights event with Representative Jason Crow (CO-06) to a District of Columbia, Maryland, and Virginia (DMV) Veterans Roundtable, these initiatives have centered the voices and lived experiences of our service members. We also featured veteran voices:
* **Interview with DNC Chair Martin:** The Chair speaks with [David, an Army Veteran](https://us.list-manage.com/18eayFlqKRG?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e), on how Democrats are fighting to protect Veteran programs and benefits.
* _**The Blue Print:**_ Featured the journey of [Peter, a Marine Corps veteran](https://us.list-manage.com/2OkEbsU_gwD?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e), tracing his transition from Marine Corps Air Station Miramar to community organizing in Minnesota as a way to illustrate civic responsibility in action.

---
|
---
| [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/13XqUTrJL8J?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e)
---
| During his visit to Austin, Chair Ken Martin joined DNC Small Business Council Chair Mark Robert Gordon and council members to engage with small business owners, including Chef Dante Foster. These entrepreneurs reflected on their challenges running a small business in this economy, such as managing payroll and coping with rising food costs amid the economic conditions under the Trump administration.
---
| [Watch the Full Video](https://us.list-manage.com/cAt60hNrUFy?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e "Watch the Full Video")
---
|
---
|
# Ongoing Opportunities
---
|
---
|
---
| **Join Our Storyteller Network!**
We’re building a national network of storytellers whose lived experiences on housing, health care, food costs, jobs, and dignity help shape how Democrats communicate and organize. These voices will guide our work and strengthen our narrative heading into 2026 and 2028.
**WHAT TO EXPECT:** Storytellers may be featured in written content, digital videos, press opportunities, or events, and can participate in optional training. See the power of these stories in our recent features on [Disability Pride Month](https://us.list-manage.com/11xufcK4n_n?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) and [Veteran Organizers](https://us.list-manage.com/4rbh7M5QAFp?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e).
**SHARE YOUR STORY** : If you or someone you know has a story that reflects the challenges and resilience of America’s working people, please fill out the form: **[Storyteller Network Form](https://us.list-manage.com/gRLffq2uW8T?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e).**
---
|
---
| **Voter Protection & Registration**
Whether it’s protecting the vote in your community, organizing an event in your neighborhood, or making sure your voter registration is up-to-date, there are plenty of ways to get involved. Ready to take action?
* **Support Voter Protection Programs:** Be a part of the team ensuring the midterm elections are fair and free. Volunteer for voter protection programs across the country.

body:
Can you spare 2 minutes of your time?

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/vpLoKi_eK2t?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
| | | | | | Peter,
I want you to understand something about Josh Shapiro and data centers.
Last summer, he was the biggest data center cheerleader in the nation. He told the world he was “comforted” that the future of AI would run through Pennsylvania. He rolled out the red carpet for out-of-state developers and told them our Commonwealth was open for business.
**And then he cashed the checks.**
More than $5 million in campaign donations from out-of-state data center interests poured into Josh Shapiro’s war chest. You probably hadn’t heard of Cyclospora before this summer.

It’s a microscopic parasite that causes gastrointestinal illness, and it’s spreading across the country right now, spiking Cyclosporiasis cases and making people sick in 41 states and counting — _and making 2026 its worst year on record._

As a doctor, I know that catching an outbreak early is a critical part of protecting the public’s health. But when you strip away the public health programs designed to keep people safe, your ability to do that is _severely_ limited. Case in point:

A year ago, RFK Jr. gutted the CDC programs responsible for tracking foodborne illness outbreaks just like this one. _He decided to make surveillance of Cyclospora optional._

Ten months later, an outbreak began. And instead of being quickly identified and contained, we found ourselves in _this_ situation:

---
But _“just eat healthy and you’ll be fine”_ ... right? That’s what Donald Trump and RFK Jr. keep saying, but that is not how outbreaks work.

You can buy organic foods, wash every fruit and vegetable, and still get sick — because contamination prevention IS NOT and CANNOT be your personal responsibility.

It is a public health job, one that was formerly held by dozens of scientists at the FDA and CDC, until those jobs were drastically scaled back: The national advisory committee that used to advise our federal agencies on how to prevent food contamination has been completely disbanded. The CDC used to have 11 scientists tracking food parasites, but now it’s down to three.

The Trump administration is choosing to ignore the science and fire the experts, and this is the result.

**RFK Jr. should be fired.**

clean_body: | | | | = From cyclosporiasis to measles, we are all witnessing the disastrous effects of a federal government that discounts science, fires experts, and guts programs designed to keep us safe. Kelly Morrison has been a doctor for over 20 years and is fighting to keep our public health policy centered in science and safety, not extreme ideology. We’re grateful to have you on this team. —Kelly for Congress HQ \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Kelly Morrison <info@kellyforcongress.org> Sent: Fri, Jul 31, 2026 Subject: A doctor’s take on the Cyclosporiasis outbreak You probably hadn’t heard of Cyclospora before this summer. It’s a microscopic parasite that causes gastrointestinal illness, and it’s spreading across the country right now, spiking Cyclosporiasis cases and making people sick in 41 states and counting — and making 2026 its worst year on record. As a doctor, I know that catching an outbreak early is a critical part of protecting the public’s health. But when you strip away the public health programs designed to keep people safe, your ability to do that is severely limited. Case in point: A year ago, RFK Jr. gutted the CDC programs responsible for tracking foodborne illness outbreaks just like this one. He decided to make surveillance of Cyclospora optional. Ten months later, an outbreak began. And instead of being quickly identified and contained, we found ourselves in this situation: But “just eat healthy and you’ll be fine” ... right? That’s what Donald Trump and RFK Jr. keep saying, but that is not how outbreaks work. You can buy organic foods, wash every fruit and vegetable, and still get sick — because contamination prevention IS NOT and CANNOT be your personal responsibility. It is a public health job, one that was formerly held by dozens of scientists at the FDA and CDC, until those jobs were drastically scaled back: The national advisory committee that used to advise our federal agencies on how to prevent food contamination has been completely disbanded. The CDC used to have 11 scientists tracking food parasites, but now it’s down to three. The Trump administration is choosing to ignore the science and fire the experts, and this is the result. RFK Jr. should be fired. Public pressure can make a difference. So please use your voice, speak out, and stay engaged. Together, we will get through this. clean_body: They said I couldn’t win last time. Now they’re saying it again. Friend, I wanted to take a minute to reach out and tell you the truth about why I'm running for the U.S. Senate. I've been the underdog my entire life. Nothing in my life has ever been handed to me -- I've had to fight for every step forward. When I first ran for the U.S. Senate, no one thought we could win. It was 2010, and I was running in what was called "Ted Kennedy's Senate seat." But with faith, grit, and the help of patriots like you, we SHOCKED the DC establishment and stopped the Democrats' supermajority in its tracks. Now, I'm back in my truck on the campaign trail, and the clueless Washington pundits are once again trying to count me out. D.C. establishment insiders are lining up behind John E. Sununu - trying to write me off, just like they did before. That's fine by me. I've never been the establishment's choice. I've always been the people's choice. New Hampshire voters are going to determine who's the nominee, not the DC insiders. These swampy DC types can't even open up the federal government, and they have a really bad record of trying to pick winners and losers. I didn't grow up with much. My dad wasn't around. I was told more than once that I'd never amount to anything. But God had a different plan. I worked my way through school, joined the Army National Guard at 19, and served proudly for nearly 40 years. Those lessons taught me that when life knocks you down, you stand back up - even when no one's cheering you on. That's exactly what this campaign is about. The fight for America's working families, not Washington elites. I won't back down. Not now. Not ever. This race in New Hampshire could decide control of the U.S. Senate and the future of our country. They can have DC insiders. I'll take the Patriots. Let's prove them wrong - again. D.C. establishment insiders are lining up behind John E. Sununu - _trying to write me off, just like they did before._
That's fine by me. I've never been the establishment's choice. **I've always been _the people's choice._**
_New Hampshire voters are going to determine who's the nominee, not the DC insiders. These swampy DC types can't even open up the federal government, and they have a really bad record of trying to pick winners and losers._

clean_body: They said I couldn’t win last time. Now they’re saying it again... Friend, I wanted to take a minute to reach out and tell you the truth about why I'm running for the U.S. Senate. I've been the underdog my entire life. Nothing in my life has ever been handed to me -- I've had to fight for every step forward. When I first ran for the U.S. Senate, no one thought we could win. It was 2010, and I was running in what was called "Ted Kennedy's Senate seat." But with faith, grit, and the help of patriots like you, we SHOCKED the DC establishment and stopped the Democrats' supermajority in its tracks. Now, I'm back in my truck on the campaign trail, and the clueless Washington pundits are once again trying to count me out. D.C. establishment insiders are lining up behind John E. Sununu - trying to write me off, just like they did before. That's fine by me. I've never been the establishment's choice. I've always been the people's choice. New Hampshire voters are going to determine who's the nominee, not the DC insiders. These swampy DC types can't even open up the federal government, and they have a really bad record of trying to pick winners and losers. I didn't grow up with much. My dad wasn't around. I was told more than once that I'd never amount to anything. But God had a different plan. I worked my way through school, joined the Army National Guard at 19, and served proudly for nearly 40 years. Those lessons taught me that when life knocks you down, you stand back up - even when no one's cheering you on. That's exactly what this campaign is about. The fight for America's working families, not Washington elites. I won't back down. Not now. Not ever. We talked about the day I was on the phone with Charlie Kirk -- less than 24 hours before he was assassinated in front of the whole world. We talked about spiritual warfare, about getting hit with smoke bombs by Antifa in the middle of a worship set, and about a promise I made to God as a 12-year-old kid on a mission trip in the Amazon. Here's the truth I keep coming back to: if you're not getting opposition in 2026 following Jesus, you're probably not following Jesus. This conversation is exactly why I wrote my new book, No Turning Back: Living as a Faithful Witness Until the Last Day. body:
We’re going to beat David Valadao together.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260820-1&t=1&akid=3901%2E587540%2E5se7g7)
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260820_1_randy.sofOE7&refcode=em20260820-3901&t=2&akid=3901%2E587540%2E5se7g7)
Peter,
I’m Randy Villegas and I’m running against Republican David Valadao in one of the most competitive congressional races in the entire country. This seat is a pure toss-up, and the outcome of this election could help decide control of the House.
**This race is CLOSE.** Right now, we’re polling **_4 points ahead_** of our opponent!
**David Valadao is one of the most vulnerable Republicans in America** — and he knows it. He stood in front of Central Valley families and promised he would never cut Medicaid, then voted for Trump's budget bill which did exactly that. He takes millions from the same corporations that have been ripping off working families in this Valley for decades. And when it mattered most, he chose his party over his people. This election, we say **_enough is enough._** We deserve real leadership.
But make no mistake: this victory won’t come easy. Outside money came after us in full force in the primary, and they’ll spend even more before Election Day.
That’s why it’s absolutely critical that we continue to have groups like Leaders We Deserve and grassroots supporters like you behind us. That’s our key to victory.
Leaders We Deserve has been instrumental in helping us reach voters across the district with our winning message. That support helped us win the primary, and between now and Election Day, I know it will make all the difference as we fight to win one of the most flippable seats in the country. But this fight needs all of us.
**[Are you ready to win one of the most competitive races in the country together? Split $5 to my campaign and Leaders We Deserve now.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260820_1_randy.sofOE7&refcode=em20260820-3901&amount=5&t=3&akid=3901%2E587540%2E5se7g7)**

Onward,
Randy Villegas

Thank you to all of you. Whether you attended this year’s County Chairs’ Brunch, purchased merch, got involved with our yearbook for Dick Durbin or the raffle, or simply opened all of our emails – we appreciate all of you.

Thanks to you, this Brunch was the most fun we’ve ever had. Over 3,000 attendees packed the BOS Center in Springfield for our largest EVER County Chairs’ Brunch.

Senator Elizabeth Warren anchored our program, with a rousing speech about how we’re going to take back Congress, and how to build our bench for the future.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137617482/641367495/214091564?si=8noo9OE69-oVEr8B&refcode=IDCCA_EMAIL_200826_FR_TY&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDU1NzIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiN2FhMDg1NGYtZGU5Yy1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAwZDNhMTFmYTMwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=i8EiVGNoyS8l9zTKI7wDiVtboVFPfJJgsvPf-IdFqXU=&emci=ff3483c5-c89c-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&emdi=7aa0854f-de9c-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ceid=81601)
We also got to honor Senator Dick Durbin, and his decades of service to our state. It was a bittersweet experience to say thank you to him, but so inspiring to see him pass the torch to the next generation. Click below to see the highlight video we produced to thank Senator Durbin for his service to our country, our state, and our Democratic Party.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137617484/641367497/214091564?si=8noo9OE69-oVEr8B&refcode=IDCCA_EMAIL_200826_FR_TY&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDU1NzIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiN2FhMDg1NGYtZGU5Yy1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAwZDNhMTFmYTMwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=i8EiVGNoyS8l9zTKI7wDiVtboVFPfJJgsvPf-IdFqXU=&emci=ff3483c5-c89c-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&emdi=7aa0854f-de9c-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ceid=81601) It was an amazing event, and we’re so proud to be able to host this every year. Here in the office, we’ve been comparing this to a Democratic party family reunion – and that’s exactly what it felt like!

Thank you for making this year’s Brunch so special,

Mark Guethle
IDCCA President

And MAGA knows it.

In a special election in deep red MAGA country that went Trump by 13 points, a Democrat didn't just win — she won BIG. Defeating a diehard MAGA Republican with Trump's "total and complete" endorsement by 24 points. A 37-point overperformance.

_As a mother who 's passionate about youth sports, I felt the urge to intervene._I didn't go for the publicity... I went to stand up for something I'm passionate about and am prepared to staunchly defend.When I first launched this campaign for U.S. Senate in Minnesota, _I knew I would have to prepare myself and my family for the pain and vitriol that would be slung my way._**But, never in my wildest dreams would I imagine something so basic to be the cause of such heated debate. Biology isn 't complicated. Women are born with a specific set of chromosomes. So are men. They're different.

**That's why we have women's divisions in sports, so women can compete on a fair playing field.

And every roster is finite. Every team excludes someone. That's not bigotry, that's how sports work.

Women's sports should belong to women.Peter, if you can agree with me on that, then I have a feeling we'll be aligned on plenty of other things.Unfortunately, my far-Left candidate is not the same. She supports biological men in girls' sports, taxpayer-funded surgeries, and largely prefers lunacy over common sense.[If you want a candidate who’s looking to restore common sense to our communities, Peter, then I’m graciously asking you to become a supporter of this movement. clean_body: | Peter, it's Michele Tafoya, and you need to hear about what happened. I was on the ground for a professional women's basketball game recently, and it's astonishing to me how this has become ground zero for the Left's latest culture wars. I heard firsthand, Leftist activists shouting obscene remarks at women, simply for saying that men don't belong in girls' sports. | As a mother who 's passionate about youth sports, I felt the urge to intervene.I didn't go for the publicity... I went to stand up for something I'm passionate about and am prepared to staunchly defend.When I first launched this campaign for U.S. Senate in Minnesota, I knew I would have to prepare myself and my family for the pain and vitriol that would be slung my way.But, never in my wildest dreams would I imagine something so basic to be the cause of such heated debate. Biology isn 't complicated. Women are born with a specific set of chromosomes. So are men. They're different. That's why we have women's divisions in sports, so women can compete on a fair playing field. And every roster is finite. Every team excludes someone. That's not bigotry, that's how sports work. Women's sports should belong to women.Peter, if you can agree with me on that, then I have a feeling we'll be aligned on plenty of other things.Unfortunately, my far-Left candidate is not the same. She supports biological men in girls' sports, taxpayer-funded surgeries, and largely prefers lunacy over common sense. | Thanks for all that you do. Your support does not go unnoticed.Be brave. Do good.- Michele The Minnesota Senate polls are TIED when voters learn the TRUTH about Minnesota's fraud scandal! I'm not surprised. There isn't a single American who is pro-fraud. But my opponent was too busy defending it or dodging it to notice. I find both disgraceful. We have the opportunity of a LIFETIME to win back this Senate seat in the name of sanity right now. | | | Paid for by Tafoya for Senate 3500 Vicksburg LN N, STE 267, Plymouth, MN 55447

By email. Effective immediately. Just months before the midterms. Sent in his own watchers. Threatened the people who count the votes.** I spent years as a federal prosecutor. I know a pattern of intent when I see one. The only problem with that excuse: Lee was not wearing headphones, and the question was asked loud and clear. Following the initial exchange, we pressed Lee: " What's wrong, you don't want to talk about ICE agents getting attacked and your rhetoric being responsible?" Lee responded by asking us if ICE was killing people. We pointed out that in the cases of ICE-involved shootings, the agents' lives were in danger because, in most cases, the vehicles were weaponized against them. Following the confrontation, Charles Downs and McBride posted back and forth about elevator doors, but it was all a diversion to make people forget that just last week, McBride wrote on his X account: " The murder of yet another person at the hands of ICE agents is one more example of what happens when this administration is able to operate with zero oversight or accountability." | | ---|---|--- McBride isn't just any ordinary member of Congress. He is a radical pro-trans activist who will do anything to force his twisted ideology on Americans. A 2023 article credits McBride with transitioning Joe Biden into a pro-trans figure, and McBride had a close relationship with Biden's late son Beau. The list of prominent House Democrats refusing to apologize for their past rhetoric calling ICE murderers also includes top House Immigration Subcommittee Democrat Pramila Jayapal, who told us that "ICE is killing people in the streets" when we asked her for an apology on the matter. As the top Democrat on the House Immigration Subcommittee, I'm demanding immediate oversight to stop these attacks." Our questioning continued with California Democrat Sara Jacobs, one of the wealthiest members of Congress. Jacobs went awfully quiet when we asked her to apologize for her past remarks calling ICE murderers. Her silence was quite telling, as Jacobs rants and raves when Trump administration officials like Marco Rubio testify before Congress, and the same holds true for her media appearances. Friend, I'm a fed-up Texan, and I bet you are too. I'm also a scientist. I spent years testing hypotheses, checking my work, and following the evidence wherever it led. Later, at the Government Accountability Office, my job was literally to find out where Washington was wasting your tax dollars and call it out. So when I look at what's happening in Big Bend National Park, I don't see a security plan. I see a handful of insiders profiting. Here's the evidence:**local sheriffs, Republicans and Democrats alike,** have said for months that a wall through Big Bend isn't about security. The numbers back them up. This stretch of border sees almost no crossings. Yet contractors have spent weeks bulldozing roads and clear-cutting land in one of the most remote and beloved corners of our state. So who's getting paid for this? Follow the money, and you land on Fisher Sand & Gravel, a company whose founder was funded in part by "We Build the Wall," the group whose own leaders went to prison for defrauding donors. That company's earlier wall segments were plagued by shoddy construction and erosion so bad that even Trump publicly disowned the project. Now it's been handed billions more, much of it without real competition, to build through Big Bend. This is exactly the kind of thing I did before running for Congress: working on congressional oversight in the U.S. Senate to hold powerful people accountable and at the GAO to protect your hard-earned taxpayer dollars. This week, after lawsuits and bipartisan backlash, CBP finally paused construction so its own commissioner could see the damage himself. But the equipment is already there. Land has already been cleared. And nobody knows if the pause will last. This is what Washington is spending our tax dollars on: dynamite in a national park and no-bid contracts for a politically connected company, instead of relief for working families. I grew up two hours from the border. I know it needs real security, and I know a bulldozer through Big Bend, run by a contractor with a track record like this, isn't it. I've spent my career rooting out this kind of waste and self-dealing, and I'm not stopping now. clean_body: Bulldozers in Big Bend, nothing for working families. | | = Friend, I'm a fed-up Texan, and I bet you are too. I'm also a scientist. I spent years testing hypotheses, checking my work, and following the evidence wherever it led. Later, at the Government Accountability Office, my job was literally to find out where Washington was wasting your tax dollars and call it out. So when I look at what's happening in Big Bend National Park, I don't see a security plan. I see a handful of insiders profiting. Here's the evidence:local sheriffs, Republicans and Democrats alike, have said for months that a wall through Big Bend isn't about security. The numbers back them up. This stretch of border sees almost no crossings. Yet contractors have spent weeks bulldozing roads and clear-cutting land in one of the most remote and beloved corners of our state. So who's getting paid for this? Follow the money, and you land on Fisher Sand & Gravel, a company whose founder was funded in part by "We Build the Wall," the group whose own leaders went to prison for defrauding donors. That company's earlier wall segments were plagued by shoddy construction and erosion so bad that even Trump publicly disowned the project. Now it's been handed billions more, much of it without real competition, to build through Big Bend. This is exactly the kind of thing I did before running for Congress: working on congressional oversight in the U.S. Senate to hold powerful people accountable and at the GAO to protect your hard-earned taxpayer dollars. This week, after lawsuits and bipartisan backlash, CBP finally paused construction so its own commissioner could see the damage himself. But the equipment is already there. Land has already been cleared. And nobody knows if the pause will last. This is what Washington is spending our tax dollars on: dynamite in a national park and no-bid contracts for a politically connected company, instead of relief for working families. I grew up two hours from the border. I know it needs real security, and I know a bulldozer through Big Bend, run by a contractor with a track record like this, isn't it. I've spent my career rooting out this kind of waste and self-dealing, and I'm not stopping now. TX-21 deserves a representative who will hold Washington accountable, not rubber-stamp it. = | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately. As a scientist and former educator, Kristin is trained to solve complex problems — whether it’s fixing our broken health care system, wealth inequality, or underfunded public schools. Kristin is poised to make history as the first woman and Latina to serve the people of TX-21 and the first PhD woman scientist to serve in Congress.
